<span style="color:#800000">4</span> The voice of Jehovah is in strength, The voice of Jehovah is in majesty.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> The voice of Jehovah breaketh the cedars; Break, I say, doth Jehovah the cedars of Lebanon.

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> And he maketh Lebanon to leap like a calf, And Sirion like the son of the unicorns.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> The voice of Jehovah striketh out flames of fire.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> The voice of Jehovah maketh the desert to tremble. Jehovah maketh to tremble the desert of Kadesh.

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> The voice of Jehovah maketh the hinds to bring forth, And discovereth the forests, And all *meanwhile* in his temple speak his praise.

<span style="color:#800000">10</span> Jehovah over the flood presideth, Preside, I say, doth Jehovah [*as*] King for ever.

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> Jehovah strength to his people will give; Jehovah will bless his people with peace.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 30</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*A Psalm of a Song at the dedication of the house of David*</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> I will exalt thee, O Jehovah! for thou hast raised me up, And hast not made glad my enemies over me.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> O Jehovah, my God! I have cried to thee, And thou hast healed me.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> O Jehovah! thou hast brought up from the grove my soul; Thou hast quickened me from among those who descend into the pit.

<!-- PAGE 880 -->

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> Sing to Jehovah, O ye his meek ones! And acknowledge the memorial of his holiness.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> For *there is only* a moment in his anger, *But* life in his favor: In the evening will lodge weeping, And in the morning shall come exultation.

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> But as for me I had said in my tranquillity, “I shall not be moved for ever.”

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> O Jehovah! in thy good pleasure Thou hast established strength to my mountain; Thou didst hide thy face, I was confounded.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> O Jehovah! to thee I cried, And to my Lord I made supplication.

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> What profit shall there be in my blood, When I descend into the pit? Celebrate thee shall the dust? Shall it proclaim thy truth?

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">10</span> Hear, O Jehovah! and have mercy upon me; O Jehovah! be thou a helper to me.</p>

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> Thou hast turned my mourning into dancing for me; Thou hast loosed my sackcloth, And girded me with gladness.

<span style="color:#800000">12</span> That celebrate thee in psalms may my glory, and not be silent: O Jehovah, my God! for ever will I celebrate thee.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 31</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*To the Chief Musician,. A Psalm of David*</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> In thee, O Jehovah! have I trusted, Let me not be put to shame for ever: In thy righteousness deliver me.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> Incline to me thy ear, Speedily do thou rescue me; Be to me for a rock of strength, For a house of defense to save me.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> For my rock, and my fortress *art* thou: And for the sake of thy name thou wilt direct and guide me.

<!-- PAGE 881 -->

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> Extricate me from the net, which they have hidden for me, For thou art my strength.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> Into thy hand I will commend my spirit; For thou hast redeemed me, O Jehovah! God of truth.

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> I hate all those who regard lying vanities; But as for me in Jehovah I have trusted.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> I will exult and rejoice in thy goodness; Because thou hast looked upon my affliction: Thou hast known in distresses my soul:

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> And thou hast not shut me up in the hand of the enemy: *But* thou hast set at large my feet.

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> Have pity upon me, O Jehovah! for trouble is to me: My eye hath consumed away for vexation; my soul and my belly.

<span style="color:#800000">10</span> My life hath riffled through grid; And my years with groaning: My strength hath sunk through my sorrow, And my bones have moldered away.

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> On account of all my enemies I was a reproach, Yea to my neighbors exceedingly, And a terror to my acquaintances; And those who saw me abroad fled from me.

<span style="color:#800000">12</span> I was forgotten as a dead man from the heart; I became like a vessel [*that is*] broken.

<span style="color:#800000">13</span> For I have heard the slander of many: Fear *hath seized* me on every side, While they consult together against me, And to take away my life do devise.

<span style="color:#800000">14</span> But as for me, in thee have I trusted, O Jehovah! I have said, “My God art thou.”

<span style="color:#800000">15</span> In thy hand are my times; Rescue me from the hand of my enemies, And from those who persecute me.

<span style="color:#800000">16</span> Cause to shine upon thy servant thy face, Save me in thy goodness.

<!-- PAGE 882 -->

<span style="color:#800000">17</span> O Jehovah! let me not be put to shame, For I have called upon thee: Let the wicked be put to shame, Let Gem be silent in the grave.

<span style="color:#800000">18</span> Let the lips of lying be put to shame, Which speak against the righteous a hard thing in pride and scorn.

<span style="color:#800000">19</span> How great is thy goodness, Which thou hast hidden for those who fear thee! Which thou hast performed for those who confide in thee, Before the sons of men!

<span style="color:#800000">20</span> Thou shalt hide them in the hidden place of thy presence, From the prides of man; Thou shalt conceal them *as* in a tent, From the strife of tongues.

<span style="color:#800000">21</span> Blessed be Jehovah! For he hath made wonderful his goodness towards me, As in a city fortified.

<span style="color:#800000">22</span> But as for me, I had said in my fear, “I am cast away from before thy eyes: “ Yet truly thou hast heard the voice of my supplications, When I cried unto thee.

<span style="color:#800000">23</span> Love Jehovah, all ye meek ones of his! The faithful preserve doth Jehovah, And he repayeth plentifully him who behaveth proudly. 2d. Be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart, All ye who hope in Jehovah.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 32</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*Of David. Giving instruction*</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> Blessed are those to whom is remitted iniquity, And whose transgression is covered.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> Blessed is the man to whom Jehovah doth not impute iniquity, And in whose spirit there is not guile.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> When I kept silence, waste away did my bones, And when I wailed all the day.

<!-- PAGE 883 -->

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> For by day and night heavy upon me was thy hand; Turned into the drought of summer was my greenness. Selah.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> My sin I have acknowledged to thee, And my iniquity I have not hid. I said, “I will confess against myself my wickedness to Jehovah;” And thou didst remit the guilt of my sin. Selah.

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> On this account, pray to thee shall every *man*, that is meek, In the time of finding thee: So that in a flood of many waters, To him they shall not come near.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> Thou art a hiding-place to me; From trouble thou shalt preserve me; With songs of deliverance thou shalt encompass me. Selah.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> I will instruct thee, And teach thee the way wherein thou shouldest walk: I will counsel thee with mine eye.

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> Be ye not like a horse, *or* like a mule, Which have not understanding: With bit and bridle his jaws thou shalt bind, Lest they kick against thee.

<span style="color:#800000">10</span> Many sorrows *shall be* to the wicked: But the man who hopeth in Jehovah goodness shall encompass.

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> Rejoice in Jehovah, and exult, ye righteous! Sing all ye *who are* upright in heart.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 33</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> Exult, ye righteous! in Jehovah: For to the upright comely is praise.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> Celebrate Jehovah upon the harp; Upon the nablure, <span style="color:#800000">ff73</span> and instrument of ten strings, sing psalms to him <span style="color:#800000">3</span> Sing to him a song that is new; Ardently sing with shouting.

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> For right *is* the word of Jehovah, And all his works are in faithfulness.

<!-- PAGE 884 -->

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> He loveth righteousness and judgment: Of the goodness of Jehovah fill is the earth.

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> By the word of Jehovah the heavens were established, And by the breath of his mouth all their host.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> He gathered together as an heap the waters of the sea; He laid up as in treasure houses the deeps.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> Let all the earth fear Jehovah; Of him let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe.

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> For he spake, and it was; He commanded, and it stood.

<span style="color:#800000">10</span> Jehovah scattereth the counsel of the Gentiles, He rendereth fruitless the imaginations of the peoples.

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> The counsel of Jehovah for ever shall stand, The thoughts of his heart from age to age.

<span style="color:#800000">12</span> Blessed is the people to whom Jehovah is their God, The people whom he hath chosen for: in inheritance to himself.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">13</span> From heavens looked down hath Jehovah, He hath beheld all the sons of Adam.</p>

<span style="color:#800000">14</span> From the dwelling place of His throne, He hath looked on all the inhabitants of the earth.

<span style="color:#800000">15</span> He who hath fashioned together their hearts, Who understandeth all their works.

<span style="color:#800000">16</span> There is not a king saved by the multitude of an host, Nor a giant rescued by greatness of strength.

<span style="color:#800000">17</span> Fallacious is a horse for safety, And by the greatness of his strength he will not deliver.

<span style="color:#800000">18</span> Behold! the eye of Jehovah is upon those who fear him, [*Upon those*] who hope in his mercy;

<span style="color:#800000">19</span> To rescue from death their souls, To keep them alive in famine.

<span style="color:#800000">20</span> Our soul waiteth for Jehovah: Our help and our shield is he.

<!-- PAGE 885 -->

<span style="color:#800000">21</span> Surely in him rejoice shall our heart, Because in his holy name we will trust.

<span style="color:#800000">22</span> Let thy mercy be upon us, O Jehovah! According as we have trusted in thee.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 34</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*Of David when he changed his countenance before Abimelech, who expelled*</span> <span style="color:#000080">*him, and he departed*</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> I will bless Jehovah at all times: Continually his praise *shall be* in my mouth.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> In Jehovah make her boast shall my soul: Hear shall the humble and be glad.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> Magnify? Jehovah with me, And let us exalt his name together.

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> I sought. Jehovah, and he answered me, And from all my fears he delivered me.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> They shall look to him, and shall flow to him, And their faces shall not he ashamed.

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> This poor man cried,: and Jehovah heard him, And from all his distresses saved him.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> Encamp doth the angel of Jehovah about those who fear him, And will deliver them.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> Taste ye and see that good is Jehovah: Blessed is the man who trusteth in him.

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> Fear Jehovah, ye saints of his; For nothing is lacking to those who fear him.

<span style="color:#800000">10</span> The young lions suffer want and are famished: But those who fear Jehovah shall not want any good thing.

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> Come ye children, hearken to me, The fear of Jehovah I will teach you.

<!-- PAGE 886 -->

<span style="color:#800000">12</span> Who is the man that desireth life, Loving days in which he may see good?

<span style="color:#800000">13</span> Keep thy tongue from evil, And thy lips from speaking deceit.

<span style="color:#800000">14</span> Depart from evil, and do good; Seek peace, and pursue it.

<span style="color:#800000">15</span> The eyes of Jehovah *are* upon the righteous, And his ears [*are open*] to their cry.

<span style="color:#800000">16</span> The face of Jehovah is upon those who do evil, To blot out from the earth their remembrance.

<span style="color:#800000">17</span> They cried, and Jehovah heard *them*, And from all their distresses he delivered them.

<span style="color:#800000">18</span> Near is Jehovah to the broken in heart; The contrite in spirit he will save.

<span style="color:#800000">19</span> Many *are* the afflictions of the righteous; But from them all deliver him will Jehovah.

<span style="color:#800000">20</span> He keepeth all his bones: One of them is not broken.

<span style="color:#800000">21</span> That malice shall slay the wicked, And those who hate the righteous shall be destroyed.

<span style="color:#800000">22</span> Redeem doth, Jehovah the soul of his servants, And they shall not perish who confide in him.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 35</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*Of David*</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> Plead, O Jehovah! with those who plead with me, Fight against those who fight against me.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> Lay hold on shield and buckler, And rise up to my aid.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> Draw out the spear, and stop my ears against my persecutors: Say to my soul, “Thy salvation am I.”

<!-- PAGE 887 -->

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> Let those be confounded and put to shame Who seek my soul, Let those be turned back and be abashed Who devise my hurt.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> Let them be as chaff before the wind? And let the angel of Jehovah drive them.

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> Let their way be darkness and slipperiness; And let the angel of Jehovah pursue them:

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> For without a cause they have hid for me the pitfall of their net, <span style="color:#800000">ff74</span> Without a cause they have digged a pit for my soul.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> Let there come upon him confusion of which he is not aware; And let the net which he hath hidden catch him; With confusion let him fall into it.

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> And my soul hath exulted in Jehovah, It shall rejoice in his salvation.

<span style="color:#800000">10</span> All my bones shall say, “O Jehovah! who is like to thee, “Rescuing the poor from him who is too strong for him, “The poor and wretched from his spoiler?”

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> Rise up do witnesses [*that are*] violent; Things which I have not known they ask me.

<span style="color:#800000">12</span> They repay me evil for good, To the bereaving of my soul.

<span style="color:#800000">13</span> But as for me, in their sickness my clothing was sackcloth: I afflicted by fasting my soul; And my prayer upon my own bosom was turned.

<span style="color:#800000">14</span> As if he had been a friend, as if a brother to me, I behaved myself *towards him*: As he who mourneth heavily for his mother I humbled myself.

<span style="color:#800000">15</span> But they at my halting rejoiced, they were assembled together: Assembled together, I say, against me, were the abjects whom I had not known: They have torn with their lips and have not been silent.

<!-- PAGE 888 -->

<span style="color:#800000">16</span> Among perfidious jesters at feasts, They gnash upon me with their teeth.

<span style="color:#800000">17</span> O Lord! how long wilt thou behold it? Rescue my soul from their violence, From the lions my only one.

<span style="color:#800000">18</span> I will celebrate thee in the congregation great: Among people many I will praise thee.

<span style="color:#800000">19</span> Let not those rejoice over me, who unjustly are my enemies; Nor let those who hate me without a cause wink with the eye.

<span style="color:#800000">20</span> For peace they speak not;

<span style="color:#800000">21</span> They have opened against me their mouth; They have said, “Aha! aha! seen *it* hath our eye.”

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">22</span> Thou hast seen *it also*, O Jehovah: Be not silent, O Lord! be not far from me.</p>

<span style="color:#800000">23</span> Arouse thyself, and awake for my judgment, My God! and my Lord! to my cause.

<span style="color:#800000">24</span> Judge me according to thy righteousness, O Jehovah, my God! And let them not rejoice over me.

<span style="color:#800000">25</span> Let them not say in their heart, “Aha! our soul!” Let them not say “We have destroyed him.”

<span style="color:#800000">26</span> Let those be ashamed and confounded together, Who rejoice at my calamity; Let those be clothed with shame and ignominy, Who magnify themselves against me.

<span style="color:#800000">27</span> *But* let those shout and rejoice, who favor my righteousness: And let them say continually, “Magnified be Jehovah! “Who loveth the peace of his servant.”

<span style="color:#800000">28</span> And my tongue shall speak of thy righteousness; All the day of thy praise.

<!-- PAGE 889 -->

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 36</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*To the Chief Musician. Of the servant of Jehovah, [εςεν of David*</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> Ungodliness saith to the wicked man in the midst of my heart, There is no fear of God before his eyes.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> For he flattereth himself in his own eyes, Until his iniquity be found to be hateful.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit, He teaseth to understand that he may do good.

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> Iniquity he meditates upon his bed; He setteth himself in a way not good; Evil he doth not abhor.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">5</span> O Jehovah! unto the heavens is thy mercy, Thy truth even unto the clouds.</p>

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> Thy justice is like the great mountains, Thy judgments are a great deep. Man and beast, thou preservest, O Jehovah!

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> How precious is thy loving-kindness, O God! Therefore the sons of men in the shadow of thy wings shall trust.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> They shall be fully satisfied with the fatness of thy house; And of the river of thy pleasures thou shalt cause them to drink.

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> For with thee is the fountain of life, And in thy light shall we see light.

<span style="color:#800000">10</span> Extend thy mercy to those who know thee, And thy righteousness to the upright in heart.

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> Let not the foot of pride come upon me; And the hand of the ungodly let it not remove me.

<span style="color:#800000">12</span> There fallen are the workers of iniquity; They are thrust down and shall not be able to stand. <span style="color:#800000">ff75</span>

<!-- PAGE 890 -->

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 37</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*Of David*</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> Vex not thyself because of the wicked, Nor be envious on account of the workers of iniquity.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> For like the grass quickly shall they be cut down; And as the green herb they shall wither.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> Trust thou in Jehovah, and do good; Dwell in the land, and be fed in truth.

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> And delight in Jehovah, And he will grant thee the request of thy heart.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> Devolve upon Jehovah thy ways, And trust in him, and he will bring it to pass.

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> And he will bring forth as the light thy righteousness, And thy judgments as the noonday.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> Be silent to Jehovah, and wait for him; Vex not thyself at him who prospereth in his way, At the man who committeth wickedness.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> Cease from anger, forsake wrath, Vex not thyself so as to commit sin.

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> For the wicked shall be cut off; But those who wait for Jehovah shall inherit the earth.

<span style="color:#800000">10</span> Yet a little while, and the ungodly shall not be; And thou shalt give attention to his place, and shalt not find *him*.

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> But the meek ones shall inherit the earth, And shall be delighted in the abundance of peace.

<span style="color:#800000">12</span> Plot doth the ungodly against the righteous, And gnasheth against him with his teeth.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">13</span> The Lord shall laugh at him, For he seeth that coming is his day.</p>

<!-- PAGE 891 -->

<span style="color:#800000">14</span> *Their* sword draw do the ungodly, And their bow they bend, To lay prostrate the poor and needy, To slay those who are upright in the way.

<span style="color:#800000">15</span> *But* their sword shall enter into their own heart, And their bow shall be broken.

<span style="color:#800000">16</span> Better is a little to the righteous man, Than the wealth of the ungodly who are great.

<span style="color:#800000">17</span> For the arms of the ungodly shall be broken; But Jehovah sustaineth the righteous.

<span style="color:#800000">18</span> Know doth Jehovah the days of the upright, And their inheritance for ever shall be.

<span style="color:#800000">19</span> They shall not be put to shame in the time of adversity; And in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.

<span style="color:#800000">20</span> For the ungodly shall perish, And the enemies of Jehovah like the fattest of lambs shall be consumed; Into smoke they shall be consumed.;

<span style="color:#800000">21</span> Borrow doth the ungodly man, and doth not repay; But the righteous man is compassionate and giveth.

<span style="color:#800000">22</span> For those who are blessed of him shall inherit the earth, And those who are cursed of him shall be cut off.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">23</span> By Jehovah the steps of a man are directed, And his way he will love.</p>

<span style="color:#800000">24</span> When he shall fall he shall not be bruised, For Jehovah putteth under [*him*] his hand.

<span style="color:#800000">25</span> Young I have been, I have also grown old; And yet I have not seen the righteous man forsaken, Nor his seed begging for bread.

<span style="color:#800000">26</span> Daily he is compassionate and lendeth, And his seed is for blessing.

<span style="color:#800000">27</span> Depart from evil and do good, And dwell for ever.

<!-- PAGE 892 -->

<span style="color:#800000">28</span> For Jehovah loveth judgment, And doth not forsake his meek ones; For ever shall they be preserved: And the seed of the ungodly shall be cut off.

<span style="color:#800000">29</span> The righteous shall inherit the earth, And shall dwell for ever upon it.

<span style="color:#800000">30</span> The mouth of the righteous shall speak wisdom;

<span style="color:#800000">31</span> The law of his God is in his heart; Slide not shall his steps.

<span style="color:#800000">32</span> Watch doth the ungodly the righteous man, And seeketh to put him to death.

<span style="color:#800000">33</span> Jehovah will not leave him in his hand, Nor condemn him when he is judged.

<span style="color:#800000">34</span> Wait for Jehovah, and keep his way, And he shall exalt thee to inherit the earth: When the ungodly shall be cut off thou shalt see it.

<span style="color:#800000">35</span> I have seen the ungodly man robust, <span style="color:#800000">ff76</span> And spreading himself like a green bay tree;

<span style="color:#800000">36</span> And he passed away, and to I he was not; And I sought for his place, and he was not found.

<span style="color:#800000">37</span> Mark the perfect man, and consider the upright; For the end of such a man is peace.

<span style="color:#800000">38</span> But transgressors shall be destroyed together: The end of the ungodly shall be cut off.

<span style="color:#800000">39</span> But the salvation of the righteous is from Jehovah: *He will* be their strength in the time of trouble.

<span style="color:#800000">40</span> And help them shall Jehovah, and deliver them: He shall deliver them from the wicked: He shall save them, because they trust in him.

<!-- PAGE 893 -->

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 38</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*A Psalm of David: to bring to remembrance*</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> O Jehovah! do not in thy fury rebuke me, And in thy wrath do not chasten me.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> For thy arrows go down in me, And descend upon me doth thy hand.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> There is no soundness in my flesh, because of thy wrath, Nor peace in my bones because of my sin.

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> For my iniquities have passed over my head, Like a burden that is weighty, they are too heavy for me.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> Putrid [*and*] corrupt have my wounds become, Because of my foolishness.

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> I am bowed down, I am brought low exceedingly; Day by day a mourner I do walk:

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> For my reins are filled with a burning heat; Nor is there soundness in my flesh.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> I am enfeebled and broken exceedingly: I have roared through the disquietude of my heart.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">9</span> O Lord! before thee is all my desire, And my groaning from thee is not hidden,</p>

<span style="color:#800000">10</span> My heart hath throbbed, forsaken me hath my strength; And the light of my eyes, it also is gone from me.

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> My friends and my companions aloof from my stroke have stood, And my kinsmen afar off have stood.

<span style="color:#800000">12</span> And they have laid snares who sought for my soul; Arid those who sought my hurt have threatened mischiefs; And deceits daily do they meditate.

<span style="color:#800000">13</span> But as for me, like a deaf man I hear not; And *I am* like a dumb man who openeth not his mouth.

<!-- PAGE 894 -->

<span style="color:#800000">14</span> And I was as a man who doth not hear, And in whose mouth there are no reproofs.

<span style="color:#800000">15</span> For on thee, O Jehovah! do I wait: Thou wilt answer *me*, O Lord, my God!

<span style="color:#800000">16</span> For I said, “Lest they should rejoice over me: “ At the slipping of my foot against me they magnified themselves, <span style="color:#800000">17</span> Surely as for me I am ready to halt; And my sorrow is before me continually.

<span style="color:#800000">18</span> Surely my iniquity I declare; I am in consternation because of my sin.

<span style="color:#800000">19</span> But my enemies are living; <span style="color:#800000">ff77</span> they are strong; And those are become mighty who hate me wrongfully.

<span style="color:#800000">20</span> And they who requite me evil for good are against me, Because I follow [*what is*] good.

<span style="color:#800000">21</span> Forsake me not, O Jehovah, my God! Be not far from me.

<span style="color:#800000">22</span> Hasten to my help, O Lord, my salvation!

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 39</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*To the Chief Musician, Jeduthun. A Psalm of David*</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> I said “I will take heed to my ways, “That I sin not with my tongue: “I will keep my mouth with a muzzle, “While the ungodly man standeth before me.”

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> I was dumb not uttering a word; I held my peace [*even*] from good; And my sorrow was stirred.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> My heart became hot within me; In my musing a fire did burn; I spake with my tongue.

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> Cause me to know, O Jehovah! my end, And the number of my days, That I may know of what duration I am.

<!-- PAGE 895 -->

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> Behold! as an handbreadth thou hast made my days, And my duration is as nothing before thee: Surely altogether vanity is every mart while he standeth.

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> Surely in a shadow man walketh; [Selah. Surely in vain is he disquieted: They heap together, and know not who shall gather.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">7</span> And now what do I wait for, O Lord? My hope is towards thee.</p>

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> From all my sins deliver thou me: The reproach of the foolish make me not.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">9</span> I was dumb; I will not open my mouth, Because thou hast done it.</p>

<span style="color:#800000">10</span> Remove from me thy stroke: By the blow of thy hand I have failed.

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> With rebukes for iniquity thou chastisest man; And causest to waste away as a moth his beauty: Surely vanity *is* every man. Selah.

<span style="color:#800000">12</span> Hear my prayer, O Jehovah! And to my cry give ear; At my tears be not silent; For a stranger am I before thee, A sojourner like all my fathers.

<span style="color:#800000">13</span> Let me alone, that I may recover strength, Before I depart and be no more.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 40</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David*</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> I have patiently waited for Jehovah, And he inclined to me, and heard my cry.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> And he drew me out of the roaring pit, Out of the mire of clay, And set upon a rock my feet; He hath established my steps.

<!-- PAGE 896 -->

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> And he hath put in my mouth a song [that ισ new, *Even* praise to our God: See shall many and shall fear, And shall trust in Jehovah.

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> Blessed is the man who maketh Jehovah his confidence, And hath not respected the proud, Nor those who turn aside to lying.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> Many, O Jehovah, my God! are thy wonderful works which thou hast done; And thy thoughts towards us it is impossible to reckon up in order to thee: I will declare and speak [*of them;*] [Βυτ they are more than can be told.

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> Sacrifice and oblation thou hast not taken pleasure in: *But* my ears hast thou made fit:  <span style="color:#800000">ff78</span> Burnt-offering and sin-offering thou hast not required.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> Then I said, “Behold! I come; “In the volume of the book it is written of me, <span style="color:#800000">8</span> “That I may do thy pleasure, O my God! “I have desired *to do it*, “And thy law is in the midst of my bowels.”

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> I have proclaimed thy righteousness in the assembly great: Behold my lips I will not restrain; O Jehovah! thou knowest it.

<span style="color:#800000">10</span> Thy righteousness I have not hidden within my heart; Thy truth and thy salvation I have declared: I have not concealed thy goodness and thy truth in the assembly great.

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> O thou, Jehovah! withhold not thy compassions from me; Let thy goodness and thy truth continually preserve me.

<span style="color:#800000">12</span> For encompassed me have evils innumerable; Laid hold upon me have my iniquities, *yea in so great number* that I cannot see them: They are more in number than the hairs of my head; *And* my heart hath failed me.

<span style="color:#800000">13</span> Let it please thee, O Jehovah! to deliver me; O Jehovah! to my aid make haste.

<!-- PAGE 897 -->

<span style="color:#800000">14</span> Let them be put to shame and confounded together Who seek after my soul to destroy it; Let them be turned backward and put to shame Who seek after my hurt.

<span style="color:#800000">15</span> Let them be destroyed for a reward of their shame, Who have said to me, “Aha! aha!”

<span style="color:#800000">16</span> Let all those exult and rejoice in thee who seek thee; And let those say continually, “May Jehovah be magnified” — “Those who love thy salvation.

<span style="color:#800000">17</span> But as for me *I am* poor and needy. Jehovah hath regarded me; My help and my deliverer *art thou*: O thou, my God! delay not.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 41</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David*</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> Blessed is he who judgeth wisely of the poor: In the day of evil Jehovah will deliver him.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> Jehovah will keep him, and preserve him alive: He shall be blessed upon the earth: And thou will not give him up to the desire of his enemies.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> Jehovah will support him upon the bed of sorrow: All his bed thou hast turned in his sickness.

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> I have said, “O Jehovah! have mercy upon me; “Heal my soul, for I have sinned against thee.”

<!-- PAGE 898 -->
<span style="color:#800000">5</span> My enemies have spoken evil of me, “When will he die, and perish shall his name? “ <span style="color:#800000">6</span> And if he come to see me falsely doth he speak; His heart gathereth iniquity to itself’: When he goeth abroad he speaketh [*it*.] <span style="color:#800000">7</span> Together against me do all my haters whisper; Against me do they devise evil for me, [*saying*,] <span style="color:#800000">8</span> “An evil deed of Belial cleaveth fast to him; “And he who lieth shall not rise again.”

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> Even the man of my peace in whom I trusted, Who eateth of my bread, hath lifted up against me the heel.

<span style="color:#800000">10</span> Do thou *then*, O Jehovah! have mercy upon me; Raise me up, and I will recompense them.

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> By this I have known that I have been acceptable to thee, Because my enemy shall not triumph over me.

<span style="color:#800000">12</span> And as for me, in my integrity thou wilt uphold me, And wilt establish me before thy face for ever.

<span style="color:#800000">13</span> Blessed *be* Jehovah, the God of Israel, For ever and ever. Amen and Amen.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1">PART SECOND.<span style="color:#800000">79</span></p>

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 42</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*To the Chief Musician. A lesson of instruction to the Sons of Korah*</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> As the hart crieth for the fountains of waters, So my soul crieth for thee, O God!

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> Thirsted hath my soul for God, for the living God: When shall I come to appear before the face of God?

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> To me have my tears been *for* bread, by day and night, While it is said to me daily, “Where is thy God? “ <span style="color:#800000">4</span> When these things I remember, I pour out within me my soul, Because I had gone with the procession, Leading them even to the house of God, With the voice of exultation and praise, — The multitude dancing for joy.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> ‘Why art thou cast down, O my soul! And why art thou disquieted within me? Wait thou for God; for I shall yet give him thanks, [*For*] the salvations of his countenance.

<!-- PAGE 899 -->

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> O my God! my soul within me is cast down, When I remember thee from the land of Jordan and of Hermonim, From the mountain Mizar.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> Deep unto deep calleth at the noise of thy waterspouts: All thy waves and all thy billows over me have gone.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> By day command will Jehovah his loving-kindness, And by night his song *shall be* with me, And prayer to the God of my life.

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> I will say to God, my Rock, “Why hast thou forgotten me? “Why mourning do I go because of the oppression of *my* enemy?”

<span style="color:#800000">10</span> [*It is as*] a wound in my bones when my enemies reproach me, Saying to me daily, “Where is thy God? “ <span style="color:#800000">11</span> ‘Why art thou cast down, O my soul? And why art thou disquieted within me? Hope in God; for I shall yet give thanks to him, The salvations of my countenance, and my God.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 43</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> Judge me, O God! and plead my cause: From a people without mercy, from a man deceitful and wicked deliver me.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> For thou *art* the God of my strength; Why art thou estranged from me? Why mourning do I go because of the oppression of the enemy?

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> Send forth thy light and thy truth; Let them direct me, let them conduct me, To the mountain of thy holiness, and to thy tabernacles.

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> And I will go to the altar of God, To the God of the joy of my rejoicing; And I will celebrate thee upon the harp, O God, my God!

<!-- PAGE 900 -->

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> Why art thou cast down, O my soul! And why art thou disquieted within me? Hope in God, for I shall yet celebrate him, *Who is* the salvation of my countenance and my God.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 44</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*To the Chief Musician. Of the sons of Korah. Giving instruction*</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> O God! with our ears we have heard, Our fathers have told us, The work which thou hast done in their days, In the days of old.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> Thou with thy hand hast expelled the heathen, and planted them: Thou hast wasted the peoples and multiplied them:

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> For not by their own sword acquired they the land, And their own arm did not save them; But thy right hand and thy arm, and the light of thy countenance, Because thou wast favorable to them.

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> Thou, even thou, *art* my King; O God! command salvations for Jacob.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> Through thee our adversaries with the horn we have pushed; In thy name we have trampled under foot those who rise up against us.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">6</span> For not in my bow will I trust, And my sword will not save me.</p>

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> Surely thou hast saved us from our enemies, And our haters thou hast put to shame.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> In God we will boast all the day, And thy name for ever shall we praise. Selah.

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> Nevertheless thou hast abhorred us and put us to shame, And thou goest not forth *any more* with our armies.

<span style="color:#800000">10</span> Thou hast made us to turn back from him that afflicteth us, And our haters have spoiled *us* for themselves.

<!-- PAGE 901 -->

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> Thou hast given us as sheep for food; And among the heathen thou hast scattered us.

<span style="color:#800000">12</span> Thou hast sold thy people, and not become rich, And thou hast not increased the price of them.

<span style="color:#800000">13</span> Thou hast made us a reproach to our neighbors, A scorn and derision to those who are round about us.

<span style="color:#800000">14</span> Thou hast made us a byword among the heathen, A shaking of the head among the peoples.

<span style="color:#800000">15</span> Daily *is* my reproach before me, And the shame of my face hath *quite* covered me, <span style="color:#800000">16</span> Because of the voice of him who reproacheth and revileth, Because of the face of the adversary and avenger.

<span style="color:#800000">17</span> All this is come upon us, and we have not forgotten thee, Nor dealt perfidiously in thy covenant;

<span style="color:#800000">18</span> Not turned back hath our heart, Nor declined have our steps from thy path.

<span style="color:#800000">19</span> Although thou hast crushed us in the place of dragons,  And covered us with the shadow of death.

<span style="color:#800000">20</span> If we have forgotten the name of our God, And have spread forth our hands to a God that is strange;

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">21</span> Shall not God search out this? For he knoweth the secrets of the heart.</p>

<span style="color:#800000">22</span> Surely for thy sake we are killed daily; We are accounted as sheep [*appointed*] for slaughter.

<span style="color:#800000">23</span> Arise, why sleepest thou, O Lord? Awake, do not forget *us* for ever.

<span style="color:#800000">24</span> Wherefore thy face dost thou hide? Wilt thou forget our misery and our affliction?

<!-- PAGE 902 -->

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">25</span> For humbled to the dust is our soul; Cleave to the earth doth our belly.</p>

<span style="color:#800000">26</span> Arise for our help, And redeem us for the sake of thy lovingkindness.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 45</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*To the Chief Musician. Upon the lilies. Of the sons of Korah. Giving*</span> <span style="color:#000080">*instruction. A Song of loves*</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> Boiling over is my heart to speak a goodly theme, Speak shall I myself of my works concerning the King: My tongue is as the pen of a swift writer.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> Thou art fair above the sons of men; Diffused is grace on thy lips; Because God hath blessed thee for ever.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> Gird thy sword upon thy thigh, O mighty one! With majesty and glory.

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> And in thy majesty prosper thou; Ride forth upon the word of truth, and meekness and righteousness; And thy right hand shall teach thee terrible things:

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> Thy arrows *are* sharp (so that the people fall under thee) In the hearts of the enemies of the king.

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> Thy throne, O God! *is* for ever and ever; The scepter of rectitude *is* the scepter of thy kingdom.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> Thou lovest righteousness and hatest impiety; Because anointed thee hath God, thy God, With the oil of gladness above thy fellows.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> Myrrh, and aloes and cassia [*are*] *in* all thy garments, Out of the ivory palaces, whence they have made thee glad.

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> The daughters of kings [*were*] among thy maids of honor; Stand did thy consort at thy right hand in gold of Ophir.

<!-- PAGE 903 -->

<span style="color:#800000">10</span> Hearken, O daughter! and consider and incline thy ear; And forget thy people, and the house of thy father.

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> And enamored shall be the King with thy beauty; For he *is* thy Lord, and thou shalt worship him.

<span style="color:#800000">12</span> And the daughter of Tyre [*shall come*] with a present; Thy favor entreat shall the rich among the people.

<span style="color:#800000">13</span> All glorious is the daughter of the King within; Of garments embroidered with gold *is* her clothing.

<span style="color:#800000">14</span> In raiment of needle-work she shall be brought to the King; Her virgins that follow her, her companions shall be brought to thee.

<span style="color:#800000">15</span> They shall be brought with joy and exultation; They shall enter into the palace of the King.

<span style="color:#800000">16</span> Instead of thy fathers shall be thy children; Thou shalt make them princes in all the earth.

<span style="color:#800000">17</span> I will make thy name to be remembered throughout all generation; Therefore celebrate thee shall the peoples for ever and ever.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 46</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*To the Chief Musician. Of the sons of Korah. Upon Alamoth. A Song*</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> God is to us a protection and strength; A help in troubles he is found exceedingly.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> Therefore we will not fear when moved shall be the earth, And fall shall the mountains into the heart of the sea.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> [*When*] roar and rage tempestuously shall the waters thereof; [*When*] shake shall the mountains with the swelling thereof. Selah.

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> The streams of her river shall make glad the city of God, The Sanctuary of the tabernacles of the Most High.

<!-- PAGE 904 -->

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> God *is* in the midst of her; she shall not be moved: Help her will God at the dawn of the morning.

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> Rage did the peoples, moved were the kingdoms: He uttered his voice, melt did the earth.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> Jehovah of armies *is* with us; A fortress for us *is* the God of Jacob. Selah.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> Come ye, consider the works of Jehovah, What desolations he hath wrought in the earth.

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> He maketh to cease battles, even to the ends of the earth; He breaketh the bow, he shattereth in pieces the arms; The chariot he burneth with fire.

<span style="color:#800000">10</span> Be still and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen; I will be exalted in the earth.

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> Jehovah of armies is with us; A fortress for us *is* the God of Jacob. Selah.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 47</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*To the Chief Musician. Of the sons of Korah. Upon Alamoth. A Song*</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> O all ye peoples! clap the hand; Shout unto God with the voice of exultation;

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> For Jehovah *is* high, terrible, A great king over all the earth.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">3</span> He hath put in order the people under us, And the nations under our feet.</p>

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> He hath chosen for us our inheritance, The glory of Jacob, whom he hath loved. Selah.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> Gone up is God with a shout, Jehovah with the sound of a trumpet.

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> Sing psalms to God, sing psalms; Sing psalms to our King, sing psalms;

<!-- PAGE 905 -->

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> For king of all the earth is God; Sing praises, all ye who understand!

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> The kingdom he hath obtained over the heathen; God sitteth upon the throne of his holiness.

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> The princes of the peoples are assembled together To the people of the God of Abraham: For to God belong the shields of the earth: He is greatly exalted.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 48</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*A Song of a Psalm. Of the sons of Korah*</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> Great is Jehovah and to be praised greatly In the city of our God, in the mountain of his holiness.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> Beautiful for situation, the joy of the whole earth, The mountain of Zion, on the sides of the north, The city of the great King.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> God in her palaces is known for a defense.

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> For behold! the kings assembled, They passed away together.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> They themselves saw, so they marveled; They were frightened, they fled precipitately, <span style="color:#800000">6</span> Fear seized upon them there, Pain as of one in travail.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> By the east wind thou breakest in pieces the ships of Tarshish.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> As we have heard, so have we seen In the city of Jehovah of Hosts, In the city of our God: God will establish it for ever. Selah <span style="color:#800000">9</span> We have waited, O God! for thy mercy In the midst of thy temple, <span style="color:#800000">10</span> As *is* thy name, O God! So *is* thy praise unto the ends of the earth: Of righteousness full is thy right hand.

<!-- PAGE 906 -->

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> Rejoice shall Mount Zion, Exult shall the daughters of Judah, Because of thy judgments.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">12</span> Encompass Zion, and walk round about her. Number the towers thereof,</p>

<span style="color:#800000">13</span> Set your heart to her walls, Exalt her towers, That ye may make report to the generations to come.

<span style="color:#800000">14</span> For this God is our God for ever and ever: He will be our guide even unto death.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 49</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*To the Chief Musician. Of the sons of Korah. A Psalm*</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> Hear this all ye peoples; Give ear all ye inhabitants of the world:

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> Both ye sons of Adam, and ye sons of men, Rich and poor together.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> My mouth shall speak of wisdoms, And the meditation of my heart is of understanding.

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> I will incline to a parable my ear: I will open upon the harp my enigma.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> Wherefore should I fear in the days of evil? The iniquity of my heel shall compass me about.

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> They trust in their wealth, And in the multitude of their riches do glory.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> The brother shall not be able to redeem; None shall give to God the price of his redemption.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> And precious shall be the redemption of their soul, And *their* continuance for ever:

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> That he should still live for ever, And not see the grave.

<!-- PAGE 907 -->

<span style="color:#800000">10</span> For he shall see that wise men die, Together the fool and the brutish person shall perish, And leave to strangers their wealth.

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> Their inward thought is [*how to make*] their houses [*to continue*] for ever, Their dwelling-places from generation to generation: They have called out their names upon the earth.

<span style="color:#800000">12</span> And man in honor shall not abide; He hath become like the beasts: they perish.

<span style="color:#800000">13</span> This their way *is* foolishness in them, And their posterity in their saying will acquiesce. Selah.

<span style="color:#800000">14</span> Like sleep in the grave they are laid; Death shall feed them; And have dominion over them shall the upright in the morning, And their strength shall wax old; The grave *shall receive* them from their dwelling.

<span style="color:#800000">15</span> But God shall redeem my soul from the hand of the grave; For he hath taken me up. Selah.

<span style="color:#800000">16</span> Be not thou afraid when a man shall become rich, When increased shall be the glory of his house;

<span style="color:#800000">17</span> For he shall not at his death carry all away: Descend not after him shall his glory:

<span style="color:#800000">18</span> For his soul in his lifetime he will bless, And they shall praise thee when thou doest well to thyself.

<span style="color:#800000">19</span> He shall come to the age of his fathers, Even for ever he shall not see the light.

<span style="color:#800000">20</span> Man *is* in honor, and will not understand: He hath become like the beasts: they shall perish.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 50</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*A Song, of Asaph*</span></p>

<!-- PAGE 908 -->

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> The God of gods, Jehovah hath spoken, And called the earth From the rising of the sun unto the going down thereof.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> Out of Zion, the Perfection of beauty, God hath shined.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> Come shall our God, and shall not keep silence; A fire before him shall devour, And round about him a tempest shall rage exceedingly.

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> He shall call to the heavens from above, And to the earth, to judge his people.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> “Gather together to me my meek ones, (*will he say*),  “Those who strike a covenant with me over sacrifices.”

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> And declare shall the heavens his righteousness: For God is judge himself. Selah.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> “Hear, O my people! and I will speak; “O Israel! and I will announce to thee:  “God, [*even*] thy God am I.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> “Not for thy sacrifices will I reprove thee; “And thy burntofferings *are* before me continually.

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> “I will not take out of thy house a calf, “*Nor* out of thy folds he-goats:

<span style="color:#800000">10</span> “For mine are all the beasts of the forest, “The cattle upon a thousand hills.

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> “I know all the birds of the mountains; “And the wild beasts of the field are at my command.

<span style="color:#800000">12</span> “If I am hungry, I will not tell thee: “For mine is the world and the fullness thereof.

<span style="color:#800000">13</span> “Will I eat the flesh of bulls, “And the blood of goats will I drink?

<span style="color:#800000">14</span> “Sacrifice unto God praise, “And pay unto the Most High thy vows.

<!-- PAGE 909 -->

<span style="color:#800000">15</span> “Call upon me in the day of trouble; “I will deliver thee, and thou shalt glorify me.

<span style="color:#800000">16</span> “But unto the wicked said hath God, “What hast thou to do to declare my statutes, “[*Or*] that thou shouldest take my covenant into thy lips?

<span style="color:#800000">17</span> “Also thou hatest correction, “And castest my words behind thee.

<span style="color:#800000">18</span> “If thou seest a thief, thou wilt run with him, “And with adulterers is thy portion.

<span style="color:#800000">19</span> “Thy mouth thou puttest forth to evil, “And thy tongue frameth deceit, <span style="color:#800000">20</span> “Thou wilt sit against thy brother; “Thou wilt speak against the sons of thy mother; “Thou wilt set forth slander.

<span style="color:#800000">21</span> “These things thou hast done, and I kept silence; “Thou thoughtest that I would be like thyself’: “I will reprove thee, and set them in order before thine eyes.

<span style="color:#800000">22</span> “Now consider this, ye who forget God, “Lest I seize upon you and there be none to deliver.

<span style="color:#800000">23</span> “He who sacrificeth praise will glorify me: “And he who ordereth his way to him will I show the salvation of God.”

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 51</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David, when Xathan the prophet came to*</span> <span style="color:#000080">*him, after he had gone in to Bathsheba*</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> Have pity upon me, O God! according to thy mercy; According to the multitude of thy compassions blot out my iniquities.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> Multiply to wash me from my sin, And from my wickedness do thou cleanse me.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> For my sins I know, And my wickedness is before me continually.

<!-- PAGE 910 -->

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> Against thee, against thee only, have I sinned, And that which was displeasing in thy sight have I done; That thou mayest be justified when thou speakest, And be pure in giving judgment.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> Behold in iniquity I was born, And in sin conceive me did my mother.

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> Behold, truth thou hast loved in the inmost parts, And in secret, wisdom thou hast made me know.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> Thou shalt purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean; Thou shalt wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> Make me to hear joy and gladness; And exult shall the bones which thou hast broken.

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> Hide thy face from my sins, And all my iniquities blot out.

<span style="color:#800000">10</span> A heart [*that is*] clean create in me, O God! And a spirit [*that is*] right renew in my inward parts.

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> Cast me not away from thy face, And the Spirit of thy holiness take not from me.

<span style="color:#800000">12</span> Restore to me the joy of thy salvation, And with a free spirit uphold me.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">13</span> I will teach transgressors thy ways, the ungodly to time shall be converted.</p>

<span style="color:#800000">14</span> Deliver me from bloods, O God! O God of my salvation! And sing aloud shall my tongue of thy righteousness.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">15</span> O Lord! my lips do thou open, And my mouth shall show forth thy praise.</p>

<span style="color:#800000">16</span> For thou wilt not accept a sacrifice; Though I should give a burnt-offering, it would not please thee.

<span style="color:#800000">17</span> The sacrifices of God are an afflicted spirit: A heart afflicted and contrite, O God! thou wilt not despise.

<!-- PAGE 911 -->

<span style="color:#800000">18</span> Do good in thy good pleasure to Zion; Build thou the walls of Jerusalem.

<span style="color:#800000">19</span> Then shalt thou accept the sacrifices of righteousness, The burnt-offering and oblation; <span style="color:#800000">ff80</span> Then shall come upon thy altar calves.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 52</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*To the Chief Musician. A lesson of instruction of David: when Doeg the*</span> <span style="color:#000080">*Edomite came and told Saul, and said to him, that David had come into the*</span> <span style="color:#000080">*house of Abimelech*</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> Why dost thou glory in thy wickedness, O mighty man? The goodness of God *continueth* daily.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> Thy tongue reckoneth up mischiefs, Like a razor [*that is*] sharp working deceitfully.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> Thou lovest wickedness more than goodness; Falsehood more than to speak righteousness. Selah.

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> Thou lovest all words of deceit, O thou tongue of guilefulness!

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> Likewise God shall destroy thee for ever: He shall lay hold on thee and pluck thee out of thy tabernacle, And root thee out of the land of the living. Selah.

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> See it also shall the righteous ones, and shall fear, And at him they shall laugh.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> Behold! the man who made not God his strength; And trusted in the abundance of his riches, And was strong in his wickedness.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> But as for me *I shall be* like an olive-tree [*that is*] green in the house of God: I have trusted in the goodness of God for ever and ever.

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> I will celebrate thee for ever, because thou hast done [*it*:]  <span style="color:#800000">ff81</span> I will wait on thy name, For it is good in the presence of thy meek ones.

<!-- PAGE 912 -->

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 53</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*To the Chief Musician, upon Mahalath. A lesson of instruction ofDavid*</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> The fool hath said in his heart, “There is not a God:” They have corrupted [*all good order*,] they have done abominable work: There is none who doeth good.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> God from heaven looked down upon the sons of men, To see if there was any who did understand, Who did seek after God.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> Every one of them hath gone back; They have all together become corrupt: There is none that doeth good, not even one.

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> Have they no knowledge, all *these* workers of iniquity? Eating my people [*as*] they eat bread: Upon Jehovah they have not called.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> There were they afraid with fear, where there was not fear; For scattered hath Jehovah the bones of him that encampeth against thee: Thou hast put them to shame because God hath despised them.

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> Who shall give out of Zion deliverance to Israel? When bring back shall God the captivity of his people, Rejoice shall Jacob, exult shall Israel.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 54</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*To the Chief Musician, on Neginoth. A lesson of instruction of David. When*</span> <span style="color:#000080">*the Ziphims came and said to Saul, “Doth not David hide himself with us?”*</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> O God! by thy name save me, And by thy strength judge me.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> O God! hear my prayer, Give ear to the words of my mouth.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> For strangers have risen up against me, And terrible ones have sought after my soul: They have not set God before them. Selah.

<!-- PAGE 913 -->

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> Behold! God is a helper to me; The Lord is with those who uphold my soul.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">5</span> He shall repay evil to my adversaries: In thy truth cut them off.</p>

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> Willingly will I sacrifice to thee; I will celebrate thy name, O Jehovah! for it is good.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> For out of all trouble he hath delivered me; And [*punishment*] upon my adversaries mine eye hath seen.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 55</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*To the Chief Musician on Neginoth. A lesson of instruction of David*</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> Give ear, O God! to my prayer, And hide not thyself from my supplication.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> Attend to me, and answer me: I will wail in my address, and will become tumultuous.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> By reason of the voice of the enemy — Under the oppression of the ungodly; For they cast upon me iniquity, In wrath they set themselves against me.

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> My heart trembleth within me, And the terrors of death have fallen upon me.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> Fear and trembling are come upon me, And horror hath overwhelmed me.

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> And I said, “Who will give me wings like a dove? “I will fly away and be at rest.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> “Lo! I will flee far away, “I will repose in the desert. Selah.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> “I will hasten my escape from the tempestuous whirlwind.”

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> Destroy, O Lord! divide their tongue: For I have seen oppression and strife in the city.

<!-- PAGE 914 -->

<span style="color:#800000">10</span> By day and night they go round it upon the walls thereof: And labor and sorrow are in the midst of it.

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> Wickedness  <span style="color:#800000">ff82</span> is in the midst of it; And fraud and deceit depart not from the streets thereof.

<span style="color:#800000">12</span> Truly it was not an enemy who reproached me, For [*then*] I could have borne [*it*:] *It was* not an adversary who magnified himself against me, For [*then*] I would have hid himself from him.

<span style="color:#800000">13</span> But thou, a man according to my own rank, My guide, and my familiar friend.

<span style="color:#800000">14</span> We sweetly exchanged our secret thoughts; Into the house of God we walked in company.

<span style="color:#800000">15</span> Let death seize upon them, Let them descend into the grave alive; For wickedness  <span style="color:#800000">ff83</span> *is* I, their dwelling, in the midst of them.

<span style="color:#800000">16</span> As for me, to God; will I cry, And Jehovah shall save me.

<span style="color:#800000">17</span> In the evening, and the morning, and at noonday Will I pray, and cry aloud; And he shall hear my voice.

<span style="color:#800000">18</span> He hath redeemed into peace my soul From the battle which was against me: For many were with me.

<span style="color:#800000">19</span> Hear shall God, and shall afflict them, Even he who sitteth from ancient time. Selah. Because they have no changes, And fear not God.

<span style="color:#800000">20</span> He hath set his hands against those who were at peace with him: He hath broken his covenant.

<span style="color:#800000">21</span> Smoother than butter are the words of his mouth, And *in* his heart *is* war; Softer are his words than oil, And [*yet*] they *are* darts.

<!-- PAGE 915 -->

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">22</span> Cast upon Jehovah whatever blessings thou askest from him, <span style="color:#800000">ff84</span></p>

And he shall feed thee; He shall not suffer for ever the righteous man to stagger.

<span style="color:#800000">23</span> Thou, O God! shalt cast them into the pit of corruption: The men of blood and deceit shall not live out half their days: But as for me, I will hope in thee.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 56</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*To the Chief Musician upon, the silent dove in distant places. Michtam of*</span> <span style="color:#000080">*David, when the Philistines took him in Gath*</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> Have mercy upon me, O God, For swallow me up doth man; He daily assaulting doth oppress me.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> Swallow me up do *my* enemies daily: Truly many *strive* to oppress me, *O Jehovah*, Most High!

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> In the day when I was afraid, I in thee did trust.

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> In God I will praise his word; In God have I trusted; I will not fear what flesh can do to me.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> Every day my words disquiet me; Against me *are* all their thoughts for evil.

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> They assemble together, they hide themselves, My heels they watch, Because they desire my soul.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> In *their* iniquity *they think* there is escape for them: In *thy* wrath the peoples thou wilt cast down, O God!

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> My wanderings thou numbereth, even thou: Put my tears into thy bottle; Are they not in thy register?

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> Then my enemies shall be turned back in the day when I cry: This I know, because God is with me.

<span style="color:#800000">10</span> In God will I praise [*his*] word; In Jehovah will I praise [*his*] word.

<!-- PAGE 916 -->

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> In God have I trusted; I will not fear what man can do to me.

<span style="color:#800000">12</span> Upon me, O God! are thy vows, I will render praises to thee.

<span style="color:#800000">13</span> For thou hast delivered my soul from death: Hast thou not *also delivered* my feet from falling? That I may walk before God in the light of the living.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 57</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*To the Chief Musician. Destroy not. Michtam of David. When he fled from*</span> <span style="color:#000080">*the face of Saul in the cave*</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> Have mercy upon me, O God! have mercy upon me; For in thee my soul doth trust; And in the shadow of thy wings will I hope, Until iniquity pass away.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> I will cry to God Most High, Who perfecteth [*his work*] towards me.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> He shall send from Heaven, And shall save me from the reproach of him who swalloweth me up: Send forth shall God his mercy and his truth.

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> My soul is in the midst of lions; I lie among those who are set on fire, — Among the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, And their tongue a sword [*that is*] sharp.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> Be thou exalted above the heavens, O God! Above all the earth thy glory.

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> A net they have prepared for my steps: Bowed down is my soul: They have digged before me a pit, *But* they have fallen into it. Selah <span style="color:#800000">7</span> Prepared *is* my heart, O God! prepared *is* my heart: I will sing, and chant psalms.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> Awake my tongue, awake nablum  <span style="color:#800000">ff85</span> and harp: I will awake at dawn of day.

<!-- PAGE 917 -->

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> I will celebrate thee, among the peoples, O Lord! I will sing psalms to thee among the nation:

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">10</span> For great unto the heavens is thy goodness, And unto the clouds thy truth.</p>

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> Be thou exalted, above the heavens, O God! Above all the earth thy glory.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 58</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*To the Chief Musician. Destroy not. Michtam of David*</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> Do ye indeed, O ye congregation! speak righteousness? Uprightly do ye judge? O ye sons of men!

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> Yea rather in *your* heart wickedness ye plot, On the earth violence your hands weigh out.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> Estranged are the ungodly from the womb, They have gone astray from their birth speaking falsehood.

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> They have poison like the poison of a serpent, [*They are*] like the deaf adder which stoppeth her ear;

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> Which listeneth not to the voice of the enchanter, — Of him who exerciseth enchantment skillfully.

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> O God! break their teeth in their mouth: The jawbones of the lions break, O Jehovah!

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> Let them melt away like water, let them be gone: Let them bend their bow, and let their arrows be as if broken.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> Like a snail which melteth away let them vanish; Like the untimely birth of a woman which doth not see the sun.

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> Before your pots can feel the fire of the bramble, *Like* flesh yet raw as a whirlwind he shall carry him away.

<span style="color:#800000">10</span> Rejoice shall the righteous when he seeth the vengeance; His hands he shall wash in the blood of the ungodly.

<!-- PAGE 918 -->

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> And men  <span style="color:#800000">ff86</span> shall say, “Truly there is fruit for the righteous, “Truly there is a God who judgeth in the earth.”

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 59</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*To the Chief Musician. Destroy not. Michtam of David. When Saul sent, and*</span> <span style="color:#000080">*they watched the house to kill him*</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> Deliver me from my enemies, O my God! from those who rise up against me set me on high.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> Deliver me from the workers of iniquity, And from men of bloods save me:

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> For lo! they have laid snares for my soul; Gathered together against me have the strong men; Not [*for*] my sin, nor [*for*] my wickedness, O Jehovah!

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> Without *any* iniquity *of mine* they have run and prepared themselves. Awake and come to meet me, and behold.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> And thou, O Jehovah, God of armies! the God of Israel! Awake to visit all the nations; Do not have compassion upon any who transgress wickedly. Selah.

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> They will return at evening; They will make a noise like a dog, And go round about the city.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> Behold they will prate with their mouth; Swords are in their lips; “For who,” *say they*, “will hear?”

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> But thou, O Jehovah! shalt laugh at them; Thou shalt hold in derision all the nations.

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> His strength with thee I will put in trust; For God is my fortress.

<span style="color:#800000">10</span> The God of my mercy shall prevent me; God will make me see my desire upon my enemies.

<!-- PAGE 919 -->

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> Slay them not, lest my people should forget; Make them to wander by thy power; And bring them down, O Lord, our shield!
