<span style="color:#800000">7</span> And the singers as the players upon instruments: All my springs *are* in thee.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 88</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*A Song of a Psalm of the sons of Korah. To the Chief Musician, upon*</span> <span style="color:#000080">*Machalath, to make humble. An instruction of Heman the Ezrahite*</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> O Jehovah! God of my salvation! By day I cry, by night before thee.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> Come into thy presence let my prayer; Incline thy ear to my cry;

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> For filled with troubles is my soul; And my life to hell  <span style="color:#800000">ff106</span> hath drawn near.

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> I am counted with those who go down to the sepulcher, <span style="color:#800000">ff107</span> I have been as a man who hath no strength:

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> Free among the dead, As the slain lying in the grave, Whom thou rememberest no more, And who from thy hand are cut off.

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> Thou hast laid me in the lowest pit, In thick darkness, in the deeps.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> Upon me lieth heavy thy indignation; And with all thy waves thou hast afflicted me. Selah.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> Thou hast removed my acquaintances from me: Thou hast made me abominations to them: I am shut up that I cannot go forth.

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> My eye mourneth because of my affliction; I invoke thee, O Jehovah! daily: I stretch out to thee my hands.

<span style="color:#800000">10</span> Wilt thou for the dead do a miracle? Shall the dead rising up praise thee? Selah.

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> Shall thy loving-kindness be declared in the grave? Thy truth in destruction?

<!-- PAGE 960 -->

<span style="color:#800000">12</span> Shall thy wonders be known in darkness? And thy righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?

<span style="color:#800000">13</span> But as for me to thee, O Jehovah! have I cried, And in the morning my prayer shall prevent thee.

<span style="color:#800000">14</span> Wherefore, O Jehovah! wilt thou reject my soul? [*Wherefore*] wilt thou hide thy face from me?

<span style="color:#800000">15</span> Afflicted am I, and ready to die from my youth; I have suffered thy terrors by doubting.

<span style="color:#800000">16</span> Passed over me hath thy fierce wrath: Thy terrors have cut me off.

<span style="color:#800000">17</span> They have encompassed me as waters daily; They have surrounded me together.

<span style="color:#800000">18</span> Thou hast removed from me lover and companion; And my acquaintances are darkness.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 89</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*An Instruction of Ethan, the Ezrahite*</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> The mercies of Jehovah for ever will I sing: From generation to generation will I celebrate thy truth with my mouth.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> For I have said, For ever Mercy shall be built up: The heavens thou shalt establish; thy truth [*is*] in them.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> “I have made a covenant with my chosen: “I have sworn to David my servant:

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> “For ever will I establish thy seed, “And I will build up from age to age thy throne.” Selah.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> And celebrate shall the heavens thy wondrous work, O Jehovah! Also thy truth in the congregation of the saints.

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> For who in the clouds can be compared to Jehovah? Who is like unto Jehovah among the sons of the gods?

<!-- PAGE 961 -->

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> God is terrible exceedingly in the assembly of the saints, And to be feared above all who are around him.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> O Jehovah, God of armies! who *is* a strong God like thee? And thy truth is round about thee.

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> Thou governest the pride of the sea: When rise up do the waves thereof, thou restrainest them.

<span style="color:#800000">10</span> Thou hast overthrown Egypt as a wounded mail; With the arm of thy strength thou hast scattered thy enemies.

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> Thine are the heavens, thine also is the earth: The world, and the fullness thereof thou hast formed. <span style="color:#800000">ff108</span> <span style="color:#800000">12</span> The north and the south thou hast created: Tabor and Hermon in thy name shall exult.

<span style="color:#800000">13</span> Thou hast an arm of might: Thou wilt strengthen thy hand, Thou wilt exalt thy right hand.

<span style="color:#800000">14</span> Righteousness and judgment *are* the seat of thy throne: Mercy and truth shall go before thy face.

<span style="color:#800000">15</span> Blessed is the people that know the joyful sound! O Jehovah! in the brightness of thy countenance they shall walk.

<span style="color:#800000">16</span> In thy name shall they exult daily; And in thy righteousness shall they glory:

<span style="color:#800000">17</span> For the glory of their strength art thou; And in thy favor exalted shall be our horn.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">18</span> For to Jehovah *is* our buckler; And to. the Holy One of Israel *is* our King.</p>

<span style="color:#800000">19</span> Then thou spakest in vision to thy meek ones, And saidst, “I have laid help upon a Mighty One; “I have exalted one chosen from among the people.

<span style="color:#800000">20</span> “I have found David my servant; “With the oil of my holiness have I anointed him.

<!-- PAGE 962 -->

<span style="color:#800000">21</span> “Therefore, my hand shall be established with him: “Yea, my arm shall strengthen him.

<span style="color:#800000">22</span> “The enemy shall not exact upon him, “Nor shall the son of iniquity afflict him.

<span style="color:#800000">23</span> “And I will break in pieces before his face his oppressors; “And those who hate him I will smite.

<span style="color:#800000">24</span> “And my truth and my mercy *shall be* with him: “And in my name exalted shall be his horn.

<span style="color:#800000">25</span> “And I will set in the sea his hand, “And in the rivers his right hand.

<span style="color:#800000">26</span> “He shall cry to me, ‘My Father art thou,  “‘My God, the Rock of my salvation.’

<span style="color:#800000">27</span> “Also I myself my firstborn will make him, “Higher than the kings of the earth.

<span style="color:#800000">28</span> “And for ever will I keep for him my mercy, “And my covenant shall stand firm with him.

<span style="color:#800000">29</span> “And I will establish for ever his seed, “And his throne as the days of heaven.

<span style="color:#800000">30</span> “If forsake shall his children my law, “And in my judgments shall not walk;

<span style="color:#800000">31</span> “If my ordinances they shall profane, “And my statutes they shall not keep;

<span style="color:#800000">32</span> “Then will I visit with my rod their transgressions, “And with stripes their iniquity.

<span style="color:#800000">33</span> “But my mercy will I not withdraw from him; “Nor will I be false in my truth.

<span style="color:#800000">34</span> “I will not profane my covenant, “And that which is gone forth from my lips I will not alter.

<!-- PAGE 963 -->
<span style="color:#800000">35</span> “Once have I sworn by my holiness, “If to David I lie — <span style="color:#800000">36</span> “His seed for ever shall endure; “And his throne as the sun before me.

<span style="color:#800000">37</span> “As the moon it shall be established for ever, “And [*as*] a faithful witness in the heaven.” Selah.

<span style="color:#800000">38</span> But thou, even thou, hast abhorred and rejected *him*; Thou hast been wroth with thy anointed.

<span style="color:#800000">39</span> Thou hast made to cease the covenant of thy servant; Thou hast profaned to the earth his crown.

<span style="color:#800000">40</span> Thou hast broken down all his walls; Thou hast made his fortresses a ruin.

<span style="color:#800000">41</span> Plundered him have all who pass by the way: He hath been a reproach to his neighbors.

<span style="color:#800000">42</span> Thou hast exalted the right hand of his oppressors; Thou hast made glad all his adversaries.

<span style="color:#800000">43</span> Also thou hast blunted the edge of his sword, And hast not made him to stand in battle.

<span style="color:#800000">44</span> Thou hast effaced his splendor, And his throne to the ground thou hast east down.

<span style="color:#800000">45</span> Thou hast shortened the days of his youth; Thou hast covered him with disgrace. Selah.

<span style="color:#800000">46</span> How long, O Jehovah! wilt thou hide thyself for ever? Burn like fire shall thy indignation?

<span style="color:#800000">47</span> Remember how short-lived I am!  <span style="color:#800000">ff109</span> Wherefore in vain shouldst thou have created all the sons of men?

<span style="color:#800000">48</span> What man shall live, and shall not see death? *And* shall deliver his soul from the hand of the grave? Selah.

<span style="color:#800000">49</span> Where *are* thy former compassions, O Lord? Thou hast sworn to David in thy truth.

<!-- PAGE 964 -->

<span style="color:#800000">50</span> Remember, O Lord! the reproach of thy servants: I have sustained in my bosom all *those* [*reproaches*] of the mighty peoples, <span style="color:#800000">51</span> With which thy enemies have reproached thee, O Jehovah! With which they have reproached the footsteps of thy Messiah.

<span style="color:#800000">52</span> Blessed *be* Jehovah for evermore. Amen and Amen!

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1">PART FOURTH.<span style="color:#800000">110</span></p>

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 90</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*A Psalm of Moses, the man of God*</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> O Lord! a dwelling-place thou hast been to us from generation to generation.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> Before the mountains were brought forth, And [*before*] thou hadst formed the earth and the world, Even from everlasting to everlasting, thou art God.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> Thou shalt turn man to destruction, And shalt say, “Return ye sons of Adam.”

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> For a thousand years in thy sight *are* as yesterday when it is past, And *as* a watch in the night.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> Thou overflowest them;  <span style="color:#800000">ff111</span> they will be a sleep: In the morning as grass he shall grow.

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> In the morning he (*or* it) shall flourish and grow: At the evening he (*or* it) shall be cut down, and shall wither.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> For we fail by thy anger, And by thy indignation are we affrighted.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> Thou hast set our iniquities before thee, Our secret sins in the light of thy countenance.

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> For all our days are passed away in thy indignation: We have spent our years as if a thought.

<!-- PAGE 965 -->

<span style="color:#800000">10</span> In the days of our years *there are* seventy years; And if through strength, eighty years, Yet is their pride [*but*] grief and labor; For it passeth by quickly, and we fly away.

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> Who knoweth the power of thy anger? And according to thy fear is thy wrath.

<span style="color:#800000">12</span> Teach us so to number our days, And we shall apply our heart to wisdom.

<span style="color:#800000">13</span> Return, O Jehovah! how long? Be pacified towards thy servants.

<span style="color:#800000">14</span> Satiate us early with thy goodness, And we will exult and rejoice all our days.

<span style="color:#800000">15</span> Make us joyful according to the days of our affliction; *According* to the years in which we have seen evil.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">16</span> Let thy work appear towards thy servants, And thy glory upon their children.</p>

<span style="color:#800000">17</span> And let there be the beauty of the Lord our God upon us; And the work of our hands direct thou upon us; Yea, the work of our hands direct thou.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 91</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> He who dwelleth in the secret place of the Most High, Under the shadow of the Almighty shall abide.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> I will say to Jehovah, “*Thou art* my hope and my fortress:” *He is* my God; I will hope in him.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, From the noxious pestilence:

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> With his wings he shall protect thee; And under his feathers thou shalt be safe; *Thy* shield and *thy* buckler *shall be* his truth.

<!-- PAGE 966 -->

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> Thou shalt not be afraid at the terror of the night; At the arrow which flieth by day;

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> At the destruction which in darkness walketh: At the pestilence which wasteth at noon-day.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> There shall fall at thy side a thousand, And ten thousand at thy right hand: To thee it shall not come nigh.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold, And the reward of the ungodly thou shalt see.

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> Because thou, O Jehovah! *art* my protection; The Most High thou hast made thy refuge.

<span style="color:#800000">10</span> There shall not befall thee [*any*] evil, And the plague shall not come nigh thy tabernacle:

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> For to his angels he hath given charge concerning thee, To keep thee in all thy ways.

<span style="color:#800000">12</span> Upon their hands they shall bear thee, Lest thou dash against a stone thy foot.

<span style="color:#800000">13</span> Over the lion and asp thou shalt walk; Thou shalt tread upon the young lion and dragon.

<span style="color:#800000">14</span> Because on me he hath reposed, I will deliver him; I will exalt him because he hath known my name.

<span style="color:#800000">15</span> He will call upon me, and I will answer him: With him will I be in trouble; I will deliver him, and will glorify him.

<span style="color:#800000">16</span> With length of days will I satisfy him, And will show him my salvation.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 92</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> It is good to give thanks to Jehovah, To sing psalms to thy name, O Most High!

<!-- PAGE 967 -->

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> To proclaim in the morning thy goodness, And thy truth in the night.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> Upon the psaltery, and upon the nablum,  <span style="color:#800000">ff112</span> Upon higgaion with the harp. <span style="color:#800000">ff113</span> <span style="color:#800000">4</span> For thou hast made me glad, O Jehovah! in thy works; In the works of thy hands I will exult.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">5</span> How magnificent are thy works, O Jehovah! Exceeding deep are thy thoughts.</p>

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> The man that is foolish shall not know them, Neither shall he who is void of wisdom understand them.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> When the wicked flourish as the grass, And all the workers of iniquity spring up, [*It is*] that they may perish for ever.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> But thou *art* exalted for evermore, O Jehovah!

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> For to! thine enemies, O Jehovah! For to! thine enemies shall perish; Scattered shall be all the workers of iniquity:

<span style="color:#800000">10</span> But thou shalt exalt my horn like *that* of the unicorn. I am anointed with fresh oil.

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> And mine eye shall see [*ruin*] on my oppressors: [*Of destruction*,] on those who rise up against me — On those who trouble me hear shall my ears.

<span style="color:#800000">12</span> The righteous as the palmtree shall flourish, As the cedar in Lebanon he shall be multiplied.

<span style="color:#800000">13</span> Planted in the house of Jehovah, In the courts of our God, they shall flourish.

<span style="color:#800000">14</span> Still shall they bud forth in old age; Fat and green shall they be;

<span style="color:#800000">15</span> That they may proclaim that upright is Jehovah, my Rock, And *that* there is no iniquity in him.

<!-- PAGE 968 -->

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 93</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> Jehovah hath reigned, He hath put on glory, Put on hath Jehovah strength; He hath girded himself: Also he hath established the world, It shall not be moved.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> Fixed is thy throne;  [*Even as*] from that time  <span style="color:#800000">ff114</span> thou art, and from eternity. <span style="color:#800000">ff115</span> <span style="color:#800000">3</span> Raised have the floods, O Jehovah! Raised have the floods their voice; Raise shall the floods their waves.

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> By reason of the voices  <span style="color:#800000">ff116</span> of the great waters Terrible are the waves of the sea: Terrible on high is Jehovah.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> Thy testimonies are verified exceedingly; To thy house *is* glory; The holiness of Jehovah *is* for length of days.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 94</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> O Jehovah! God of vengeances! O God of vengeances! shine forth.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> Lift up thyself; O judge of the earth! Render a reward to the proud.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> How long shall the ungodly, O Jehovah! How long shall the ungodly triumph?

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> They pour forth, they speak hard things, Extol themselves do all the workers of iniquity.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> Thy people, O Jehovah! they break in pieces; And thy inheritance they afflict:

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> The widow, and the stranger they slay, And the orphans they put to death.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> And they have said, “God shall not see, “The God of Jacob shall not know..”

<!-- PAGE 969 -->

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> Understand, ye stupid among the people! And ye fools! when will ye be wise?

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> He who planted the ear shall not He hear? He who formed the eye, shall not He see?

<span style="color:#800000">10</span> He who chastiseth the nations, shall not He correct? He who teacheth man knowledge?

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> Jehovah knoweth the thoughts of men that they are vain.

<span style="color:#800000">12</span> Blessed *is* the man whom thou hast instructed, O God! And out of thy law hast taught;

<span style="color:#800000">13</span> To give him rest from days of evil, Whilst there is digged for the ungodly [*man*] a pit.

<span style="color:#800000">14</span> Surely Jehovah will not cast off his people, And his inheritance he will not forsake.

<span style="color:#800000">15</span> For return shall judgment unto righteousness, And [*follow*] after him shall all the upright in heart.

<span style="color:#800000">16</span> Who will rise up for me against my adversaries? Who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?

<span style="color:#800000">17</span> Unless Jehovah had been a help to me, My soul had well-nigh dwelt in silence.

<span style="color:#800000">18</span> If I said, “Slidden hath my foot,” Thy goodness, O Jehovah! hath sustained me.

<span style="color:#800000">19</span> In the multitude of my thoughts, Within me thy comforts cheer my soul.

<span style="color:#800000">20</span> Shall the throne of iniquities have fellowship with thee, Framing molestation for law?

<span style="color:#800000">21</span> They will gather together against the soul of the righteous, And the blood of the innocent they will condemn.

<span style="color:#800000">22</span> But Jehovah hath been to me for a fortress; And my God for the rock of my confidence:

<!-- PAGE 970 -->

<span style="color:#800000">23</span> And he shall retribute upon them their own iniquity, And in their wickedness he shall destroy them; Destroy them shall Jehovah our God.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 95</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> Come let us exult to Jehovah; Let us shout for joy to the Rock of our salvation.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> Let us come before his face with praise, In psalms let us shout for joy unto him.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> For a great God *is* Jehovah, And a great King, above all gods.

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> For in his hand *are* the deep places of the earth; And the heights of the mountains are his.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> For his is the sea, and he made it; And the dry land his hands formed.

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> Come ye, let us worship, and fall down; Let us kneel before the face of Jehovah, our Maker.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> For he *is* our God, And we [*are*] the people of his pastures, And the flock of his hand; To-day, if his voice ye will hear, <span style="color:#800000">8</span> Harden not your heart, as in Meribah; As in the day of Massah in the desert,

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">9</span> When tempt me did your fathers; They proved me, though they had seen my work.</p>

<span style="color:#800000">10</span> Forty years I strove with this generation, And said, “They are a people erring in heart, “And they have not known my ways.”

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">11</span> Wherefore I swear in my wrath, “If they shall enter into my rest —”</p>

<!-- PAGE 971 -->

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 96</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> Sing ye to Jehovah a song that is new, Sing to Jehovah all the earth.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> Sing to Jehovah, bless his name; Publish from day to day his salvation.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> Tell among the heathen his glory; Among all the peoples his wonders.

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> For great *is* Jehovah, and to be praised highly; Terrible [*is*] he above all gods.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> For all the gods of the nations are vanities; But Jehovah made the heavens.

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> Strength and majesty *go* before him; Power and glory *are* in his sanctuary.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> Ascribe to Jehovah, O ye congregations of peoples! Ascribe to Jehovah glory and strength.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> Ascribe to Jehovah the glory of his name; Bring an offering, and enter into his courts.

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> Worship before Jehovah in the beauty of the sanctuary; Tremble before his face let the whole earth.

<span style="color:#800000">10</span> Say ye among the heathen, “Jehovah reigneth; “Truly established shall be the world, it shall not be moved: “He shall judge the peoples in righteousness.”

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> Rejoice let the heavens, and exult let the earth; Thunder let the sea, and the fullness thereof.

<span style="color:#800000">12</span> Exult let the field, and all that is in it; Shout for joy together let all the trees of the wood <span style="color:#800000">13</span> Before Jehovah; for he cometh, For he cometh to judge the earth: He shall judge the world in righteousness, And the peoples in his truth.

<!-- PAGE 972 -->

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 97</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> Jehovah reigneth: Exult let the earth, Rejoice let the great islands.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> Clouds and darkness *are* round about him; Righteousness and judgment *are* the seat of his throne.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> A fire before his face shall go, And shall burn up round about his enemies.

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> Enlighten did his lightnings the world; See and tremble shall the earth.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> The mountains like wax melted at the presence of Jehovah, At the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> Declared have the heavens his righteousness, And seen have all the peoples his glory.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> Confounded be all those who serve graven images, Who glory in *their* inventions: Worship before him let all the gods.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> Heard and rejoiced hath Zion; Exulted have the daughters of Judah, Because of thy judgments, O Jehovah!

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> For thou, O Jehovah! *art* high above all the earth: Exceedingly exalted art thou above all gods.

<span style="color:#800000">10</span> Ye who love Jehovah, hate evil: He preserveth the souls of his meek ones; From the hand of the ungodly he will deliver them.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">11</span> Light is sown for the righteous, And for the upright in heart joy.</p>

<span style="color:#800000">12</span> Rejoice, O ye righteous! in Jehovah, And celebrate the memory of his holiness.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 98</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*A Psalm*</span></p>

<!-- PAGE 973 -->

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> Sing ye to Jehovah a song that is new, For marvels he hath done: Salvation wrought for him hath his own right hand, And the arm of his holiness.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> Made known hath Jehovah his salvation: In the sight of the heathen he hath revealed his righteousness.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> He hath remembered his goodness and *his* truth towards the house of Israel: Seen have all the ends of the earth the salvation of our God.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">4</span> Exult to Jehovah all the earth; Make a loud noise, and exult, and sing psalms.</p>

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> Sing psalms to Jehovah upon the harp, Upon the harp, and with the voice of song:

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> With trumpets, and the voice of the cornet, Sing psalms before the King, Jehovah.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> Roar let the sea, and the fullness thereof; The world, and those who dwell therein.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> Let the floods clap the hand: Together let the mountains exult <span style="color:#800000">9</span> Before Jehovah: for he cometh to judge the earth; He shall judge the world in righteousness, And the peoples with rectitude.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 99</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> Jehovah reigneth; tremble let the people: He dwelleth *between* the cherubim; moved let be the earth.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> Jehovah in Zion is great; And exalted is he above all nations.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> They shall acknowledge thy great and terrible name: It is holy.

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> And the strength of the king loveth judgment; Thou hast established rectitude; Judgement and righteousness in Jacob thou hast done.

<!-- PAGE 974 -->

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> Exalt ye Jehovah our God, And worship at his footstool: He is holy.

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> Moses and Aaron among his priests, And Samuel among those who call upon his name; They cried to Jehovah and he answered them.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> In the pillar of the cloud he spake to them: They kept his testimonies And his statutes which he gave them.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> O Jehovah, our God! thou didst answer them: A God propitious thou wast to them, And [*yet*] taking vengeance upon their works.

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> Exalt ye Jehovah our God, And worship at the mountain of his holiness; For holy *is* Jehovah our God.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 100</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*A Psalm for praising*</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> Sing aloud to Jehovah, <span style="color:#800000">ff117</span> all ye *inhabitants* of the earth.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> Serve Jehovah with gladness; Come into his presence with exultation.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> Know that Jehovah He is God; He made us, and not we ourselves: *We are* his people, and the flock of his pasture.

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> Enter his gates with praise, his courts with exultation; Celebrate him, <span style="color:#800000">ff118</span> bless his name:

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> For good is Jehovah, For ever *endureth* his mercy, And from generation to generation his truth.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 101</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*A Psalm of David*</span></p>

<!-- PAGE 975 -->

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> Of mercy and judgment I will sing; To thee, O Jehovah, will I sing psalms.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> I will act wisely in a perfect way, Until thou comest to me; I will walk in the integrity of my heart in the midst of my house.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> I will not set before my eyes a wicked thing; The work of those who turn aside I hate; It shall not adhere to me.

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> A heart perverse shall depart from me; Evil I will not know.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> He who slandereth in secret his neighbor, him will I destroy: The lofty in look and the wide in heart him I will not suffer.

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> My eyes *shall be* upon the faithful of the land, That they may dwell with me: He who walketh in an upright way, [*Even*] he shall minister to me.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> He shall not dwell in the midst of my house, he who worketh deceit; He who speaketh lies shall not be established before my eyes.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> Early will I destroy all the ungodly of the land; That I may cut off from the city of Jehovah all the workers of iniquity.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 102</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*A Prayer for the afflicted when he shall be shut up, and shall pour out his*</span> <span style="color:#000080">*meditation before Jehovah*</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> O Jehovah! hear my prayer, And let my cry to thee come.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> Hide not thy face from me in the day of my afflictions; Incline to me thy ear; In the day when I cry, make haste, answer me.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> For consumed like smoke are  <span style="color:#800000">ff119</span> my days, And my bones as a hearth are burnt up.

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> Smitten like grass, and withered is my heart, Because I have forgotten to eat my bread.

<!-- PAGE 976 -->

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> By reason of the voice of my groaning, Cleave do my bones to my flesh.

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> I am become like a pelican of the desert, I am become as an owl of the solitudes;

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> I have watched and am as the sparrow *Which is* solitary upon the roof of the house.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> Daily reproach me do my enemies; And those who are mad against me, by me have sworn.

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> For ashes as bread I have eaten, And my drink with weeping <span style="color:#800000">ff120</span> I have mingled.

<span style="color:#800000">10</span> Because of thy indignation and thy wrath; For thou hast lifted me up and cast me down.

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> My days *are* as a shadow which declineth; And as grass I am dried up.

<span style="color:#800000">12</span> And thou, O Jehovah! for ever shalt dwell, And thy memorial from generation to generation.

<span style="color:#800000">13</span> Thou thyself shalt arise, thou shalt have mercy upon Zion; For it is time to compassionate her, For come is the appointed time.

<span style="color:#800000">14</span> For take pleasure do thy servants in her stones, And upon her dust they will have compassion.

<span style="color:#800000">15</span> And fear shall the Gentiles the name of Jehovah, And all the kings of the earth thy glory.

<span style="color:#800000">16</span> For Jehovah hath builded Zion, He hath appeared in his glory.

<span style="color:#800000">17</span> He hath regarded the prayer of the solitary, And hath not despised their prayer.

<span style="color:#800000">18</span> This shall be written for the generation to come, And the people [*to be*] created shall praise him.

<!-- PAGE 977 -->
<span style="color:#800000">19</span> For he hath looked from the high *place* of his holiness, Jehovah from the heavens upon the earth hath looked, <span style="color:#800000">20</span> To hear the groaning of the prisoners To release the sons of death;

<span style="color:#800000">21</span> That declared in Zion may be the name of Jehovah, And his praise in Jerusalem;

<span style="color:#800000">22</span> When gathered shall be the peoples together, And the kingdoms to serve Jehovah.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">23</span> He hath afflicted in the way my strength, He hath shortened my days.</p>

<span style="color:#800000">24</span> I said, O my God! take me not away in the midst of my days; *For* throughout generations of generations *are* thy years.

<span style="color:#800000">25</span> Aforetime the earth thou hast founded; And the work of thy hands serve the heavens.

<span style="color:#800000">26</span> They shall perish but thou shalt endure; And they all as a garment shall grow old; As a vesture thou shalt change them, and they shall be changed.

<span style="color:#800000">27</span> But thou *art always* the same, And thy years shall not fail.

<span style="color:#800000">28</span> The children of thy servants shall dwell, And their seed before thee shall be established.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 103</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*Of David*</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> Bless, O my soul! Jehovah, And all my inward parts *bless* his holy name.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> Bless, O my soul! Jehovah, And forget not all his bounties.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">3</span> Who forgiveth all thy iniquities; Who healeth all thy infirmities;</p>

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> Who redeemeth from the grave thy life; Who crowneth thee with mercy and compassions;

<!-- PAGE 978 -->

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> Who satisfieth with good thy mouth: Renewed as *that* of the eagle shall be thy youth.

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> Execute doth Jehovah righteousness And judgments for all who are oppressed.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> He made known his ways to Moses, To the children of Israel his doings.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> Compassionate and merciful *is* Jehovah, Slow to anger and abundant in goodness.

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> He will not always chide; Neither for ever will he keep [h*is anger*.] <span style="color:#800000">10</span> Not according to our sins hath he dealt with us, Nor according to our iniquities hath he recompensed us.

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> For in proportion to the height of the heavens above the earth, Hath been the greatness of his goodness upon those who fear him.

<span style="color:#800000">12</span> As far distant as is the east from the west, So far hath he removed from us our sills.

<span style="color:#800000">13</span> As a father is compassionate towards his children, So is Jehovah compassionate towards those who fear him.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">14</span> For he knoweth of what we are made; He hath remembered that dust are we.</p>

<span style="color:#800000">15</span> Man… as grass *are* his days: As a flower of the field, so he flourisheth.

<span style="color:#800000">16</span> As soon as the wind passeth over it, it is not; And know it no more shall the place thereof.

<span style="color:#800000">17</span> But the goodness of Jehovah *is* from everlasting to everlasting upon those who fear him, And his righteousness upon the children’s children;

<span style="color:#800000">18</span> To those who keep his covenant, And are mindful of his statutes to do them.

<!-- PAGE 979 -->

<span style="color:#800000">19</span> Jehovah in the heavens hath established his throne; And his kingdom over all hath dominion.

<span style="color:#800000">20</span> Bless Jehovah, *ye* his angels mighty in strength! Who do his commandment, in hearing the voice of his word.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">21</span> Bless Jehovah, all *ye* his armies! Ye ministers of his, who do his pleasure.</p>

<span style="color:#800000">22</span> Bless Jehovah, all ye his works! In all places of his dominion: Bless, O my soul! Jehovah.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 104</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> Bless, O my soul! Jehovah: O Jehovah, my God! thou art great exceedingly; With praise and honor thou hast clothed thyself.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> Being arrayed with light as with a garment; Spreading out the heavens as a curtain;

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> Flooring in the waters his upper rooms; Making the clouds his chariot; Walking upon the wings of the wind:

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> Making the winds his messengers; His ministers a fire that flameth.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> He hath founded the earth upon its foundations, So that it shall not be moved for ever.

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> With the deep as with a garment he hath covered it: Above the mountains stand shall the waters.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> At thy rebuke they shall flee; At the voice of thy thunder they shall suddenly pass away.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> Ascend shall the mountains and descend shall the valleys To the place which thou hast founded for them.

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> A boundary thou hast set, they shall not pass over *it*: They shall not return to cover the earth.

<!-- PAGE 980 -->

<span style="color:#800000">10</span> Sending out springs by the valleys, *Which* between the hills shall run.

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> Drink *thereof* shall all the beasts of the field: Quench shall the wild asses their thirst.

<span style="color:#800000">12</span> Nigh time the fowl of the heaven shall dwell, From the midst of the branches they shall send out their voice.

<span style="color:#800000">13</span> Watering the mountains from his chambers: From the fruit of thy works satisfied shall be the earth.

<span style="color:#800000">14</span> Making grass to grow for cattle, And herb for the service of mm: That he may bring forth bread out of the earth.

<span style="color:#800000">15</span> And wine cheereth the heart of man, To make *his* face to shine with oil, And bread sustaineth the heart of man.

<span style="color:#800000">16</span> Satiated shall be the trees of Jehovah; The cedars of Lebanon which he hath planted:

<span style="color:#800000">17</span> For there the birds build their nests: [*As for*] the stork, the fir trees are her dwelling.

<span style="color:#800000">18</span> The high mountains *are* for the deer; The rocks a place of shelter for the hedgehogs.

<span style="color:#800000">19</span> He hath made the moon for set times: The sun knoweth his going down.

<span style="color:#800000">20</span> Thou makest darkness, and it is night; Wherein do creep forth all the beasts of the forest.

<span style="color:#800000">21</span> The lions roar after their prey, And in seeking from God their food.

<span style="color:#800000">22</span> Rise shall the sun, and they shall gather themselves together, And in their dens shall lie down.

<span style="color:#800000">23</span> Go forth shall man to his work, And to his labor, until the evening.

<!-- PAGE 981 -->

<span style="color:#800000">24</span> How magnificent are thy works! O Jehovah! All things in wisdom thou hast made: Filled is the earth with thy riches.

<span style="color:#800000">25</span> This sea great, and wide in extent; Therein are creeping things inntanerable, Beasts both small and great.

<span style="color:#800000">26</span> There the ships go, And the leviathan, which thou hast formed to sport in it.

<span style="color:#800000">27</span> All things on thee do wait, That thou mayest give *them* their food in its season.

<span style="color:#800000">28</span> Thou shalt give it them, they shall gather [*it*:] Thou shalt open thy hand, they shall be satisfied with good.

<span style="color:#800000">29</span> Thou shalt hide thy face, they shall be afraid: Thou shalt take away their spirit, they shall die, and to their dust shall return.

<span style="color:#800000">30</span> Thou shalt send forth thy Spirit, they shall be created: And thou shalt renew the face of the earth.

<span style="color:#800000">31</span> Glory be to Jehovah for ever: Rejoice let Jehovah in his works.

<span style="color:#800000">32</span> He looketh upon the earth, and it trembleth: If he touch the mountains, they shall smoke.

<span style="color:#800000">33</span> I will sing to Jehovah whilst I live: I will sing psalms to my God as long as I have my being.

<span style="color:#800000">34</span> Let my speech be acceptable to him: I will rejoice in Jehovah.

<span style="color:#800000">35</span> Perish let sinners from the earth, And the ungodly till they cease to be any more. Bless, O my soul! Jehovah. Hallelujah.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 105</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> Celebrate ye Jehovah; invoke his name: Announce among the peoples his works.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> Sing ye to him: sing psalms to him: Speak of all his wonders.

<!-- PAGE 982 -->

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> Rejoice ye in his holy name: Rejoice let the heart of those who seek Jehovah.

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> Seek ye Jehovah, and his strength; Seek his face continually.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> Remember the marvelous works which he hath done; His wonders, and the judgments of his mouth.

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> *Ye* seed of Abraham, his servant, The sons of Jacob his chosen one:

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">7</span> He *is* Jehovah our God; Through all the earth are his judgments.</p>

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> He hath remembered for ever his covenant, The word *which* he commanded to a thousand generations:

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> Which he made with Abraham, And his oath *which he swore* to Isaac;

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">10</span> And established it to Jacob for a law, To Israel for an everlasting covenant:</p>

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> Saying, “To thee will I give the land of Canaan, “The cord of your inheritance.”

<span style="color:#800000">12</span> When they were very few in number; And strangers in it;

<span style="color:#800000">13</span> And walked about from nation to nation, From *one* kingdom to another people, <span style="color:#800000">14</span> He did not suffer men to hurt them; And rebuked for their sake kings;

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">15</span> *Saying*, “Touch not my anointed ones, “And to my prophets do no harm.”</p>

<span style="color:#800000">16</span> And he called a famine upon the land; All the stall of bread he broke.

<span style="color:#800000">17</span> He sent before them a man, For a slave sold was Joseph.

<span style="color:#800000">18</span> They afflicted in the fetters his feet: The iron entered into his soul:

<!-- PAGE 983 -->

<span style="color:#800000">19</span> Until the time that his word came: The word of Jehovah tried him.

<span style="color:#800000">20</span> Send did the king and loosed him; Even the ruler of the peoples, and freed him.

<span style="color:#800000">21</span> He made him lord over his house; And ruler over all his substance:

<span style="color:#800000">22</span> To bind his princes at his pleasure; And to teach his elders wisdom.

<span style="color:#800000">23</span> And come did Israel into Egypt; And Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.

<span style="color:#800000">24</span> And he increased his people exceedingly, He multiplied them above their oppressors.

<span style="color:#800000">25</span> He turned their heart so that they hated his people, And dealt craftily with his servants.

<span style="color:#800000">26</span> He sent Moses, his servant; Aaron, whom he chose.

<span style="color:#800000">27</span> They set among them the words of his signs, And *his* miracles in the land of Ham.

<span style="color:#800000">28</span> He sent darkness, and made it dark; And they were not rebellious against his words.

<span style="color:#800000">29</span> He turned their waters into blood, And killed their fish.

<span style="color:#800000">30</span> Their land brought forth frogs, *Yea even* within the chambers of their kings.

<span style="color:#800000">31</span> He spake and there came a swarm of flies, Lice in all their borders.

<span style="color:#800000">32</span> He gave them for rain, hail, Flaming fire upon their land.

<span style="color:#800000">33</span> And he smote their vines and their fig-trees; And destroyed *every* tree of their border.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">34</span> He spake, and there came the locust, And the caterpillar without number;</p>

<!-- PAGE 984 -->

<span style="color:#800000">35</span> And they devoured all the herbage in their land, And consumed the fruit of their ground.

<span style="color:#800000">36</span> And he smote all the firstborn in their land, The beginning of all their strength.

<span style="color:#800000">37</span> And he brought them forth with silver and gold: And not one among their tribes was a feeble person.

<span style="color:#800000">38</span> Glad was Egypt at their departure; For fallen upon them had their terror.

<span style="color:#800000">39</span> He spread out a cloud for a covering; And fire to give light by the night.

<span style="color:#800000">40</span> He  <span style="color:#800000">ff121</span> asked, and brought quails, And with the bread of heaven he filled them.

<span style="color:#800000">41</span> He opened the rock, and there gushed out waters; They ran in the dry *places like* a river.

<span style="color:#800000">42</span> For he remembered the word of his holiness, *Which he had spoken* to Abraham his servant.

<span style="color:#800000">43</span> And he brought forth his people with joy, With exultation his chosen ones.

<span style="color:#800000">44</span> And he gave them the lands of the nations: And the labor of the peoples they inherited.

<span style="color:#800000">45</span> That they might keep his ordinances, And that his law they might observe. Hallelujah.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 106</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*Hallelujah*</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> Celebrate Jehovah, for he is good; For to everlasting *is* his mercy.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> Who shall express the mighty acts of Jehovah? Who shall declare all his praise?

<!-- PAGE 985 -->

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> Blessed are they who keep judgment, *Blessed* is he who doeth righteousness at all times.

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> Remember me, O Jehovah! with the good will [*which thou bearest towards*] thy people. Visit me with thy salvation;

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> That I may see the good of thy chosen ones, That I may rejoice in the joy of thy nation, That I may glory with thy heritage.

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> We have sinned with our fathers, We have acted iniquitously, we have done wickedly.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> Our fathers in Egypt understood not thy wonders; They remembered not the multitude of thy kindnesses; And they rebelled at the sea, at the Red Sea.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> Yet he saved them for the sake of his own name, That. he might cause to be known his power.

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> And he rebuked the Red Sea, and it was dried up; And he made them walk in the deeps as in a desert.

<span style="color:#800000">10</span> And he saved them from the hand of the enemy, And redeemed them from the hand of the adversary.

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> And cover did the waters their oppressors: One of them was not left.

<span style="color:#800000">12</span> Then they believed his words; They sang his praise.

<span style="color:#800000">13</span> They made haste, they forgat his works; They did not wait for his counsel;

<span style="color:#800000">14</span> And they lusted greatly in the desert, And tempted God in the wilderness.

<span style="color:#800000">15</span> And he gave them their request; But sent leanness into their souls.

<span style="color:#800000">16</span> And they envied Moses in the camp, And Aaron, the saint of Jehovah.

<!-- PAGE 986 -->

<span style="color:#800000">17</span> Open did the earth and swallowed up Dathan, And covered over the tent of Abiram.

<span style="color:#800000">18</span> And kindled was a fire in their company, The flame burned up the ungodly.

<span style="color:#800000">19</span> They made a calf in Horeb, And worshipped before the molten image.

<span style="color:#800000">20</span> And they changed their glory Into the likeness of an ox that eateth hay.

<span style="color:#800000">21</span> They forgat God their Savior, Who had done great things in Egypt;

<span style="color:#800000">22</span> Miracles in the land of Ham, Terrible things at the Red Sea.

<span style="color:#800000">23</span> And he said that he would destroy them, Unless Moses his chosen had stood in the breach before his face, To turn away his wrath, that he might not destroy *them*.

<span style="color:#800000">24</span> And they despised the land of pleasantness; They believed not his word;

<span style="color:#800000">25</span> And they mutinied in their tents, They hearkened not to the voice of Jehovah.

<span style="color:#800000">26</span> And he lifted tip his hand against them, To destroy them in the desert:

<span style="color:#800000">27</span> And to scatter their seed among the heathen, And to disperse them throughout the lands.

<span style="color:#800000">28</span> And they joined themselves to Baal-peor, And ate the sacrifices of *things* dead.

<span style="color:#800000">29</span> And they provoked *God* to anger by their works: And break in upon them did the plague.

<span style="color:#800000">30</span> Then stood up Phinehas, and executed judgment: And stayed was the plague.

<!-- PAGE 987 -->

<span style="color:#800000">31</span> And *that* was imputed to him for righteousness From generation to generation, even for ever.

<span style="color:#800000">32</span> And they provoked *him* to anger at the waters of strife, And it turned out in to Moses on their account:

<span style="color:#800000">33</span> For they embittered his spirit, And he spake [*rashly*] with his lips.

<span style="color:#800000">34</span> They did not destroy the nations, As Jehovah had commanded them:

<span style="color:#800000">35</span> And they were mingled with the heathen, And learned their works:

<span style="color:#800000">36</span> And they served their idols; Which were to them for ruin.

<span style="color:#800000">37</span> And they sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons;

<span style="color:#800000">38</span> And they shed innocent blood, The blood of their sons and of their daughters, Whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan; And polluted was the land with bloods.

<span style="color:#800000">39</span> And they were defiled in their own works, And were adulterous in their own inventions.

<span style="color:#800000">40</span> Then  <span style="color:#800000">ff122</span> burn did the wrath of Jehovah against his people, And he abhorred his inheritance;

<span style="color:#800000">41</span> And he delivered them into the hands of the heathen; And those had dominion over them who hated them:

<span style="color:#800000">42</span> And subdue them did their enemies, And they were afflicted under their hand.

<span style="color:#800000">43</span> Many times did he deliver them; But they provoked *him* with their counsels, And were oppressed in their iniquity.

<span style="color:#800000">44</span> Yet he saw when they were in distress, And heard their cry:

<span style="color:#800000">45</span> And he remembered towards them his covenant; And it repented him according to the greatness of his mercies.

<!-- PAGE 988 -->

<span style="color:#800000">46</span> And he made them to find pity Before all who had led them captive.

<span style="color:#800000">47</span> Save us, O Jehovah, our God! And gather us from among the heathen, That we may celebrate thy holy name, That we may glory in thy praise.

<span style="color:#800000">48</span> Blessed *be* Jehovah, the God of Israel, From everlasting to everlasting; And say let all the people, Amen. Praise ye Jehovah.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1">PART FIFTH.<span style="color:#800000">123</span></p>

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 107</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> “Celebrate Jehovah, for he is good, “For to everlasting is his mercy.”

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> Say *this* let the redeemed of Jehovah, Whom he hath redeemed from the hand of the afflicter.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> Whom he hath gathered from the lands, From the east, and from the west, From the north, and from the south.

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> They wandered from the way in the solitary desert; A city of habitation they found not:

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> Hungry, also thirsty, *So that* their soul within them fainted.

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> Then they cried to Jehovah in their distress, And from their troubles he delivered them.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> And he directed them by a right way, That they might come to a city of habitation.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> Let them celebrate before Jehovah his mercy, His marvelous works before the sons of men.

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> For he hath satisfied the soul that longeth, And the soul that is famished he hath filled with good.

<!-- PAGE 989 -->

<span style="color:#800000">10</span> Those who dwell in darkness, and in the shadow of death, Bound in affliction and iron;

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> Because they rebelled against the words of God, And the counsel of the Most High they despised:

<span style="color:#800000">12</span> And he humbled with trouble their heart; They were afflicted and *there was* none to help *them*.

<span style="color:#800000">13</span> They cried to Jehovah in their distress: From their troubles he delivered them.

<span style="color:#800000">14</span> He rescued them from darkness and the shadow of death, And their chains he broke asunder.

<span style="color:#800000">15</span> Let them celebrate before Jehovah his mercy, And his marvelous works before the sons of men.

<span style="color:#800000">16</span> For he hath broken the gates of brass, And the bars of iron he hath shivered.

<span style="color:#800000">17</span> Fools on account of the way of their transgression; And on account of their iniquities are afflicted.

<span style="color:#800000">18</span> All food loathe doth their soul; And they approach the gates of death.

<span style="color:#800000">19</span> Then they cry to Jehovah in their trouble: From their straits he sayeth them.

<span style="color:#800000">20</span> He sendeth his word, and healeth them, And rescueth them from all their corruptions.

<span style="color:#800000">21</span> Let them celebrate before Jehovah his mercy, And his marvelous works before the sons of men.

<span style="color:#800000">22</span> And let them sacrifice sacrifices of praise, And announce his works with exultation.

<span style="color:#800000">23</span> Those who go down to the sea in ships, Trading in the great waters, <span style="color:#800000">24</span> These men see the works of Jehovah, His wonders in the deep.

<!-- PAGE 990 -->

<span style="color:#800000">25</span> He speaketh and raiseth the wind of storm, And lifteth high the waves thereof.

<span style="color:#800000">26</span> They mount up to the heavens, They descend into the deeps; Their soul in  <span style="color:#800000">ff124</span> *their* distress is melted away.

<span style="color:#800000">27</span> They are tossed and stagger as a drunken man, And all their skill is swallowed up.

<span style="color:#800000">28</span> And they cry to Jehovah in their distress, And from their troubles he bringeth them out.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">29</span> He maketh the storm a calm, So that quiet are the waves thereof.</p>

<span style="color:#800000">30</span> And they rejoice because they are stilled; And he leadeth them unto the haven of their desire.

<span style="color:#800000">31</span> Let them celebrate before Jehovah his mercy, And his wonders before the sons of men;

<span style="color:#800000">32</span> And let them exalt him in the congregation of the people, And in the assembly of the elders let them praise him.

<span style="color:#800000">33</span> He turneth rivers into a desert, And springs of water into dryness;

<span style="color:#800000">34</span> A land that is fruitful into saltness, For the wickedness of those who dwell therein.

<span style="color:#800000">35</span> He turneth the desert into a pool of water, And the land of barrenness into springs of water.

<span style="color:#800000">36</span> And there he causeth to dwell the famished, That they may prepare a city of habitation;

<span style="color:#800000">37</span> And sow fields, and plant vineyards, And eat the fruit of increase.

<span style="color:#800000">38</span> And he blesseth them, and they multiply exceedingly; And their cattle he doth not diminish,.

<span style="color:#800000">39</span> Afterwards they are diminished and brought low, By reason of anguish, affliction, and sorrow.

<!-- PAGE 991 -->

<span style="color:#800000">40</span> He poureth contempt upon princes, And maketh them to wander in the waste where there is no path.

<span style="color:#800000">41</span> And he raiseth the afflicted from *his* misery, And maketh like a flock [*his*] families.

<span style="color:#800000">42</span> See shall the upright ones and shall rejoice: And all iniquity shall stop her mouth.

<span style="color:#800000">43</span> Who is wise, and he will observe these things, And they shall understand the loving-kindness of Jehovah?

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 108</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*A Song of a Psalm of David*</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> Prepared *is* my heart, O God! prepared is my heart, I will chant and will sing psalms, even with my glory.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> Awake, psaltery and harp: I will arise at the dawn of day.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> I will celebrate thee, among the peoples, O Jehovah! And will sing psalms to thee among the nations:

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> For great above the heavens, is thy goodness; And unto the clouds is thy truth.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> Be thou exalted above the heavens, O God! And above all the earth thy glory:

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> That thy beloved ones may be delivered: Save by thy right hand, and hear me.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice: I will divide Shechem, And the valley of Succoth I will measure.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> Mine *is* Gilead, mine is Manasseh; And Ephraim *is* the strength of my head; Judah my lawgiver.

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> Moab the pot for my washing; Over Edom will I cast my shoe; Over Palestina will I triumph.

<!-- PAGE 992 -->

<span style="color:#800000">10</span> Who will lead me into the city fortified? Who will lead me even into Edom?

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> Wilt not thou, O God! who hadst cast us off? And [*thou*] O God! [*who*] didst not go forth with our armies?

<span style="color:#800000">12</span> Grant us relief from  <span style="color:#800000">ff125</span> trouble; For vain is the help of man.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">13</span> Through God we shall do valiantly, And he shall tread down our adversaries.</p>

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 109</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David*</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> O God of my praise! be not silent;

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> For the mouth of the ungodly man, and the mouth of deceit upon me are opened; They have talked with me with a tongue of guile:

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> And with words of hatred they have encompassed me, And have fought against me without a cause.

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> [*In return*] for my love they have been my adversaries; But I *set myself* to prayer.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> And they have requited me evil for good, And hatred for my love.

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> Set thou over him an ungodly man; And let the adversary stand at his right hand.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> When he is judged let him go forth condemned,  <span style="color:#800000">ff126</span> And let his prayer be turned into sin.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> Let his days be few; His office let another receive.

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> Let his children be fatherless, And his wife a widow.

<!-- PAGE 993 -->
<span style="color:#800000">10</span> And in wandering let his children wander and beg,  <span style="color:#800000">ff127</span> And seek [*for bread*] out of their waste places. <span style="color:#800000">ff128</span> <span style="color:#800000">11</span> Catch let the extortioner all which he hath, And let strangers plunder his labor.

<span style="color:#800000">12</span> Let there be none prolonging mercy to him; And let there be none to have compassion upon his orphans.

<span style="color:#800000">13</span> Let his posterity be destroyed;  <span style="color:#800000">ff129</span> In the generation following let their name be blotted out.

<span style="color:#800000">14</span> Remembered let be the iniquity of his fathers before Jehovah; And the wickedness  <span style="color:#800000">ff130</span> of his mother let it not be blotted out.

<span style="color:#800000">15</span> Let them be before Jehovah continually, And let him blot out from the earth their memorial;

<span style="color:#800000">16</span> Because he remembered not to do mercy, And persecuted the man [*that was*] wretched and poor, And afflicted in heart, to put *him* to death.

<span style="color:#800000">17</span> He loved cursing, and let it come upon him: He delighted not in blessing, and let it be far from him.

<span style="color:#800000">18</span> And let him be clothed with cursing as with a garment; And let it come as water into his entrails, And as oil into his bones.

<span style="color:#800000">19</span> Let it be to him as a mantle to cover him, And as a girdle with which continually he may gird himself <span style="color:#800000">20</span> Let this be the recompense  <span style="color:#800000">ff131</span> of my adversaries from Jehovah, And of those who speak evil against my soul.

<span style="color:#800000">21</span> But thou, O Jehovah, my Lord! deal thou with me for the sake of thy name: Because good *is* thy mercy, deliver me;

<span style="color:#800000">22</span> For poor and needy I am, And my heart is wounded within me.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">23</span> As a shadow when it declineth, I walk about; I am shaken off as the locust.</p>

<span style="color:#800000">24</span> My knees are become feeble through fasting; And my flesh hath fallen away from *its* fatness.

<!-- PAGE 994 -->

<span style="color:#800000">25</span> But I am become a reproach to them; When they see me they shake their head.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">26</span> Help me, O Jehovah, my God! Save me according to thy mercy.</p>

<span style="color:#800000">27</span> And they shall know that this is thy hand, *That* thou, O Jehovah! hast done it.

<span style="color:#800000">28</span> They shall curse, but thou shalt bless; When they rise up they shall be put to shame; But thy servant shall rejoice.

<span style="color:#800000">29</span> Clothed shall be my adversaries with disgrace, And they shall be covered as with a garment with their own shame.

<span style="color:#800000">30</span> I will praise Jehovah greatly with my mouth; And in the midst of the great I will celebrate him:

<span style="color:#800000">31</span> Because he standeth at the right hand of the poor one, To save from condemnations his soul.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 110</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*A Psalm of David*</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> Jehovah said to my Lord, “Sit thou at my right hand, “Until I make thy enemies thy footstool.”

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> The scepter of thy power send shall Jehovah out of Zion: Rule thou in the midst of thy enemies.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> Thy people *shall come* with voluntary offerings, On the day *of the assembling* of thy army, In beauty of holiness: From the womb as from the morning dawn To thee *has been* the dew of thy youth.

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> Sworn hath Jehovah, and he will not repent: “Thou art a priest for ever “According to the manner of Melchisedek.”

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">5</span> The Lord at thy right hand Hath crushed in the day of his wrath kings.</p>

<!-- PAGE 995 -->

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> He shall judge among the heathen, He shall fill *all* with ruins; He shall crush the head over a great country.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> Of the torrent in the way he shall drink, Therefore shall he lift up the head.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 111</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*Hallelujah*</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> <span style="color:#008080">א</span> I will celebrate Jehovah with *my* whole heart, <span style="color:#008080">ב</span> In the congregation of the just, and in the assembly.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> <span style="color:#008080">ג</span> Great are the works of Jehovah, <span style="color:#008080">ד</span> Sought out of all who have pleasure in them.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> <span style="color:#008080">ה</span> Beautiful and honorable  <span style="color:#800000">ff132</span> *is* his work; <span style="color:#008080">ו</span> And his righteousness endureth for ever.

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> <span style="color:#008080">ז</span> He hath made a memorial by his wonderful works: <span style="color:#008080">ח</span> Merciful and compassionate *is* Jehovah.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> <span style="color:#008080">ט</span> A portion he hath given to those who fear him: <span style="color:#008080">י</span> He will remember for ever his covenant.

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> <span style="color:#008080">כ</span> The might of his works he hath proclaimed to his people, <span style="color:#008080">ל</span> To give them the heritage of the heathen.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">7</span> <span style="color:#008080">מ</span> The works of his hands *are* truth and judgment: <span style="color:#008080">נ</span> True *are* all his statutes,</p>

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> <span style="color:#008080">ס</span> And established for ever — <span style="color:#008080">ע</span> Made in truth and rectitude.

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> <span style="color:#008080">פ</span> Redemption he hath sent to his people; <span style="color:#008080">צ</span> He hath commanded for ever his covenant: <span style="color:#008080">ק</span> Holy and terrible *is* his name.

<span style="color:#800000">10</span> <span style="color:#008080">ר</span> The beginning of wisdom is the fear of Jehovah; <span style="color:#008080">ש</span> A good understanding *have* all those who do them: <span style="color:#008080">ת</span> His praise endureth for ever.

<!-- PAGE 996 -->

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 112</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*Hallelujah*</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> <span style="color:#008080">א</span> Blessed is the man who feareth Jehovah; <span style="color:#008080">ב</span> In his commandments he will delight greatly.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> <span style="color:#008080">ג</span> Mighty on the earth shall be his seed: <span style="color:#008080">ד</span> The generation of the upright ones shall be blessed.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> <span style="color:#008080">ה</span> Wealth and riches *shall be* in his house; <span style="color:#008080">ו</span> And his righteousness endureth for ever.

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> <span style="color:#008080">ז</span> There ariseth in darkness light to the upright ones: <span style="color:#008080">ח</span> *He is* merciful and compassionate and righteous.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> <span style="color:#008080">ט</span> A good man showeth pity and lendeth; <span style="color:#008080">י</span> He manageth his affairs  <span style="color:#800000">ff133</span> in uprightness.

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> <span style="color:#008080">כ</span> Truly he shall not for ever be moved; <span style="color:#008080">ל</span> In everlasting remembrance shall be the righteous one.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> <span style="color:#008080">מ</span> Of evil tidings he shall not be afraid; <span style="color:#008080">נ</span> Established is his heart, because he trusteth in Jehovah.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> <span style="color:#008080">ס</span> Sustained *is* his heart, he shall not be afraid, <span style="color:#008080">ע</span> Until he see *his desire* upon his adversaries.

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> <span style="color:#008080">פ</span> He hath dispersed; he hath given to the poor ones; <span style="color:#008080">צ</span> His righteousness continueth for ever; <span style="color:#008080">ק</span> His horn shall be exalted with glory.

<span style="color:#800000">10</span> <span style="color:#008080">ר</span> The ungodly one shall see *it*, and be incensed; <span style="color:#008080">ש</span> With his teeth he shall gnash and waste away: <span style="color:#008080">ת</span> The desire of the ungodly ones shall perish.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 113</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*Hallelujah*</span></p>

<!-- PAGE 997 -->

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> Praise ye, O ye servants of Jehovah! Praise ye the name of Jehovah.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> Let the name of Jehovah be blessed, From henceforth and for ever.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> From the rising of the sun even to his going down, Worthy to be praised *is* the name of Jehovah.

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> High above all nations *is* Jehovah, Above the heavens is his glory.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> Who *is* like Jehovah our God, <span style="color:#800000">6</span> Who hath his dwelling on high,  <span style="color:#800000">ff134</span> Who humbleth himself to behold *that which* is done in heaven and on earth?

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> Who raiseth from the dust the needy one; From the dunghill he lifteth up the wretched one;

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> To make him sit with princes, With the princes of his people.

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> Who causeth the barren woman to dwell with a family, Rejoicing that *she is* a mother of children. Hallelujah.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 114</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> When Israel went forth from Egypt, The house of Jacob from a people barbarous;

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> [*Then*] was Judah for his holiness, Israel, his dominions.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> The sea saw, and fled, Jordan was turned backward.

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> The mountains leaped as rams, The hills as the lambs of the flock.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> What ailed thee, O sea! that thou fleddest? *And thou*, O Jordan! *that* thou wast turned back?

<!-- PAGE 998 -->

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> Ye mountains, *that* ye leaped like rams; Ye hills, as the lambs of the flock? 7, At the presence of the Lord, tremble, O earth! At the presence of the God of Jacob;

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> Who turned the rock into pools of water, The flinty rock into a fountain of waters.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 115</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> Not to us, O Jehovah! not to us, But to thy name give glory, On account of thy mercy, on account of thy truth.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> Why should the heathen say, “Where *is* now their God?”

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> But our God *is* in the heaven: Whatever pleased him he hath done.

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> Their idols *are* silver and gold, The work of the hands of men.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> A mouth have they,  <span style="color:#800000">ff135</span> and they do not speak: Eyes have they, and they do not see:

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> Ears have they, and they do not hear: Noses have they, and they do not smell:

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> Hands have they, and they do not feel: Feet have they, and they do not walk: They do not speak through their throat.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">8</span> Like to them shall be those who make them, And every one who trusteth in them.</p>

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> O Israel! trust thou in Jehovah: Their help and their shield is He:

<span style="color:#800000">10</span> O house of Aaron! trust in Jehovah: Their help and their shield is he:

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> Ye who fear Jehovah! trust in Jehovah: Their help and their shield *is* He.

<span style="color:#800000">12</span> Jehovah hath remembered us; he will bless us; He will bless the house of Israel; He will bless the house of Aaron.

<!-- PAGE 999 -->
