<span style="color:#800000">13</span> He will bless those who fear Jehovah, The small together with the great.

<span style="color:#800000">14</span> Jehovah will add to you, To you and to your children.

<span style="color:#800000">15</span> Blessed are ye of Jehovah, Who made heaven and earth.

<span style="color:#800000">16</span> The heavens, the heavens *are* Jehovah’s: But the earth he hath given to the sons of men.

<span style="color:#800000">17</span> The dead shall not praise *thee*, O God! Nor any who go down into silence.

<span style="color:#800000">18</span> But as for us we will bless God, From this time, and even for evermore. Hallelujah.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 116</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> I have loved, because heard hath Jehovah the voice of my prayer;

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> Because he hath inclined his ear to me, When in my straits I called upon him. <span style="color:#800000">ff136</span> <span style="color:#800000">3</span> They encompassed me, the snares of death, And the sorrows of the grave found me: Trouble and grief I found.

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> And on the name of Jehovah I will call: “I beseech thee, O Jehovah! deliver my soul.”

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> Merciful *is* Jehovah and righteous; And our God *is* compassionate.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">6</span> Guard doth Jehovah the simple: I was brought low and he saved me.</p>

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> Return, O my soul! to thy rest; For Jehovah hath dealt kindly with thee. <span style="color:#800000">ff137</span> <span style="color:#800000">8</span> Because thou hast rescued my soul from death My eye from tears, My foot from falling.

<!-- PAGE 1000 -->

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> I will walk before Jehovah in the land of the living.

<span style="color:#800000">10</span> I have believed, for I will speak: “I am afflicted greatly.”

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> I said in my fear, “Every man is a liar.”

<span style="color:#800000">12</span> What shall I render to Jehovah? All his benefits *are* upon me.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">13</span> The cup of salvation I will take, And upon the name of Jehovah I will call.</p>

<span style="color:#800000">14</span> My vows to, Jehovah I will perform Now in the presence of all his people.

<span style="color:#800000">15</span> Precious in the eyes of Jehovah is the death of his meek ones.

<span style="color:#800000">16</span> Come! O Jehovah! for I, *am* thy servant; I *am* thy servant, the son of thy handmaid; Thou hast broken my fetters.

<span style="color:#800000">17</span> To thee will I sacrifice the sacrifice of praise, And upon the name of Jehovah will I call.

<span style="color:#800000">18</span> My vows to Jehovah will I perform Now in the presence of all his people, <span style="color:#800000">19</span> In the courts of the house of Jehovah In the midst of thee, O Jerusalem! Hallelujah.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 117</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> Praise ye Jehovah, all ye nations! Celebrate him all ye peoples!

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> For great towards us is his mercy, And the truth of Jehovah *continueth* for ever. Hallelujah.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 118</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">1</span> Celebrate ye Jehovah! for *he is* good: For to everlasting *endureth* his mercy.</p>

<!-- PAGE 1001 -->

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> Let now Israel say: “For  <span style="color:#800000">ff138</span> to everlasting *endureth* his mercy.”

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> Let now the house of Aaron say: “For to everlasting *endureth* his mercy.”

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> Let now those who fear Jehovah say: “For to everlasting *endureth* his mercy.”

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> In my distress I called upon God; God answered me *by setting me* at large.

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> Jehovah *is* with me: I will not fear what man can do to me.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> Jehovah *is* with me among those who help me, And I shall see *my desire* upon my adversaries.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">8</span> It is better to hope in Jehovah Than to place confidence in man:</p>

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> It is better to hope in Jehovah Than to place confidence in princes.

<span style="color:#800000">10</span> All the nations encompassed me: *But* in the name of Jehovah I will surely cut them off.

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> They encompassed me, yea they encompassed me, *But* in the name of Jehovah I will surely cut them off’.

<span style="color:#800000">12</span> They encompassed me as bees: They were extinguished as a fire of thorns: In the name of Jehovah I will surely cut them off.

<span style="color:#800000">13</span> Thou hast thrust and  <span style="color:#800000">ff139</span> thrust at me, that I might fall: But Jehovah helped me.

<span style="color:#800000">14</span> My strength and *my* song is God, And he hath become to me salvation.

<span style="color:#800000">15</span> The voice of exultation and salvation is in the tabernacles of the righteous: The right hand of Jehovah hath done valiantly.

<span style="color:#800000">16</span> The right hand of Jehovah is exalted, The right hand of Jehovah hath done valiantly.

<span style="color:#800000">17</span> I shall not die, yea, I shall live, And recount the works of God.

<!-- PAGE 1002 -->

<span style="color:#800000">18</span> Chastised me sorely hath  <span style="color:#800000">ff140</span> God; But he hath not delivered me up unto death.

<span style="color:#800000">19</span> Open to me the gates of righteousness; *And* having entered into them, I will celebrate God.

<span style="color:#800000">20</span> This is the gate of Jehovah, The just ones shall enter into it.

<span style="color:#800000">21</span> I will celebrate thee because thou hast heard me, And hast been my salvation.

<span style="color:#800000">22</span> The stone which the builders rejected Is become the head [*stone*] of the corner.

<span style="color:#800000">23</span> By Jehovah hath this been done: It is marvelous in our eyes.

<span style="color:#800000">24</span> This *is* the day which Jehovah hath made; Let us exult and rejoice in it.

<span style="color:#800000">25</span> I beseech thee, O Jehovah! save me; I beseech thee, I beseech thee, O Jehovah! give prosperity I beseech thee.

<span style="color:#800000">26</span> Blessed is he who cometh in the name of Jehovah: We bless you from the house of Jehovah.

<span style="color:#800000">27</span> God *is* Jehovah, and he hath given light to us: Bind ye the lamb with cords, even to the horns of the altar.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">28</span> My God art thou, and I will celebrate thee: My God, I will exalt thee.</p>

<span style="color:#800000">29</span> Celebrate ye Jehovah; for *he is* good: For to everlasting *is* his mercy.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 119</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#008080">א</span> [Aleph.]</p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> <span style="color:#008080">א</span> Blessed *are* those who are upright in *their* way, Walking in the law of Jehovah.

<!-- PAGE 1003 -->

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> <span style="color:#008080">א</span> Blessed *are* those who keep his testimonies, *Who* with *their* whole heart seek him.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> <span style="color:#008080">א</span>, Surely they do not work iniquity, *Who* in his ways do walk.

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> <span style="color:#008080">א</span> Thou hast commanded That thy statutes be kept carefully.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> <span style="color:#008080">א</span> O that my ways may be directed To the keeping of thy statutes!

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> <span style="color:#008080">א</span> Then shall I not be ashamed, When I shall have been attentive to all thy commandments.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> <span style="color:#008080">א</span> I will celebrate thee with uprightness of heart, When I shall have learned the judgments of thy righteousness.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> <span style="color:#008080">א</span>, Thy statutes I will keep: Do not thou forsake me very far.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#008080">ב</span> [Beth.]</p>

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> <span style="color:#008080">ב</span> By what [*means*] shall a young man cleanse his way? By taking heed according to thy word.

<span style="color:#800000">10</span> <span style="color:#008080">ב</span> With my whole heart have I sought thee; Let me not go astray from thy commandments.

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> <span style="color:#008080">ב</span> In my heart I have hidden thy word, That I might not sin against thee.

<span style="color:#800000">12</span> <span style="color:#008080">ב</span> Blessed *art* thou, O Jehovah! Teach me thy statutes.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">13</span> <span style="color:#008080">ב</span> With my lips have I declared All the judgments of thy mouth.</p>

<span style="color:#800000">14</span> <span style="color:#008080">ב</span> In the way of thy testimonies I have taken delight, As much as in all riches.

<span style="color:#800000">15</span> <span style="color:#008080">ב</span> Upon thy statutes will I meditate, And I will consider thy paths.

<span style="color:#800000">16</span> <span style="color:#008080">ב</span> In thy commandments will I delight myself; I will not forget thy words.

<!-- PAGE 1004 -->

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#008080">ג</span> [Gimel.]</p>

<span style="color:#800000">17</span> <span style="color:#008080">ג</span> Do good to thy servant, And I shall live and keep thy word.

<span style="color:#800000">18</span> <span style="color:#008080">ג</span> Open mine eyes, And I shall behold the wonders of thy law.

<span style="color:#800000">19</span> <span style="color:#008080">ג</span> I am a stranger on the earth: Hide not from me thy commandments.

<span style="color:#800000">20</span> <span style="color:#008080">ג</span> Broken is my soul with the desire *it hath* To thy judgments at all times.

<span style="color:#800000">21</span> <span style="color:#008080">ג</span> Thou hast destroyed the proud ones; Cursed are those who decline from thy commandments.

<span style="color:#800000">22</span> <span style="color:#008080">ג</span> Remove from me reproach and contempt; For thy testimonies I have kept.

<span style="color:#800000">23</span> <span style="color:#008080">ג</span> Princes also have sat, against me they have spoken: Thy servant meditated upon thy statutes.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">24</span> <span style="color:#008080">ג</span> Also thy testimonies *are* my delights, The men of my counsel.</p>

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#008080">ד</span> [Daleth.]</p>

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">25</span> <span style="color:#008080">ד</span> Cleave to the dust doth my soul: Quicken me according to thy word.</p>

<span style="color:#800000">26</span> <span style="color:#008080">ד</span> I have declared my ways, and thou hast answered me: Teach me thy statutes.

<span style="color:#800000">27</span> <span style="color:#008080">ד</span> The way of thy commandments make me to understand, And I will meditate upon thy wonders.

<span style="color:#800000">28</span> <span style="color:#008080">ד</span> Drop away doth my soul for grief: Raise me up according to thy word.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">29</span> <span style="color:#008080">ד</span> The way of falsehood remove from me, And thy law grant me graciously.</p>

<span style="color:#800000">30</span> <span style="color:#008080">ד</span> The way of truth I have chosen; Thy judgments I have set before me.

<!-- PAGE 1005 -->

<span style="color:#800000">31</span> <span style="color:#008080">ד</span> I have cleaved to thy testimonies, O Jehovah Let me not be put to shame.

<span style="color:#800000">32</span> <span style="color:#008080">ד</span> The way of thy statutes I will run, When thou shalt have enlarged my heart.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#008080">ה</span> [He.]</p>

<span style="color:#800000">33</span> <span style="color:#008080">ה</span> Teach me, O Jehovah! the way of thy statutes, And I will keep it unto the end.

<span style="color:#800000">34</span> <span style="color:#008080">ה</span> Make me to understand, and I will observe thy law, And keep it with my whole heart.

<span style="color:#800000">35</span> <span style="color:#008080">ה</span> Direct me in the way of thy statutes; For in it is my delight.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">36</span> <span style="color:#008080">ה</span> Incline my heart to thy testimonies, And not to covetousness.</p>

<span style="color:#800000">37</span> <span style="color:#008080">ה</span> Turn away my eyes from seeing vanity; In thy way quicken me.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">38</span> <span style="color:#008080">ה</span> Confirm to thy servant thy word, Who to thy fear *is devoted*.</p>

<span style="color:#800000">39</span> <span style="color:#008080">ה</span> Remove my reproach which I have dreaded, For thy judgments are good.

<span style="color:#800000">40</span> <span style="color:#008080">ה</span> Behold! I have longed after thy commandments: In thy righteousness quicken me.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#008080">ו</span>[Vau.]</p>

<span style="color:#800000">41</span> <span style="color:#008080">ו</span> And let come to me thy mercies, O Jehovah! Thy salvation according to thy word.

<span style="color:#800000">42</span> <span style="color:#008080">ו</span> And I will answer a word to him who reproacheth me; For I have trusted in thy word.

<span style="color:#800000">43</span> <span style="color:#008080">ו</span> And take not from my mouth the word of truth utterly: Because for thy judgments I wait.

<span style="color:#800000">44</span> <span style="color:#008080">ו</span> And I will keep thy law continually, For ever and ever.

<!-- PAGE 1006 -->

<span style="color:#800000">45</span> <span style="color:#008080">ו</span> And I will walk at large; For thy statutes I have sought.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">46</span> <span style="color:#008080">ו</span> And I will speak of thy testimonies before kings, And will not be ashamed.</p>

<span style="color:#800000">47</span> <span style="color:#008080">ו</span> And I will delight myself in thy commandments Which I have loved.

<span style="color:#800000">48</span> <span style="color:#008080">ו</span> And I will lift up my hands to thy commandments Which I have loved; And I will meditate upon thy statutes.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#008080">ז</span> [Zain.]</p>

<span style="color:#800000">49</span> <span style="color:#008080">ז</span> Remember thy word to thy servant, Upon which thou hast caused me to hope.

<span style="color:#800000">50</span> <span style="color:#008080">ז</span> This is my consolation in my affliction; For thy word revives me.

<span style="color:#800000">51</span> <span style="color:#008080">ז</span> The proud ones have derided me exceedingly: From thy law I have not declined.

<span style="color:#800000">52</span> <span style="color:#008080">ז</span> I remembered thy judgments of old, O Jehovah! And comforted myself.

<span style="color:#800000">53</span> <span style="color:#008080">ז</span> Terror hath seized upon me, Because of the ungodly who forsake thy law.

<span style="color:#800000">54</span> <span style="color:#008080">ז</span> Thy statutes have been songs to me In the house of my pilgrimage.

<span style="color:#800000">55</span> <span style="color:#008080">ז</span> I remembered in the night thy name, O Jehovah! And I will keep thy law.

<span style="color:#800000">56</span> <span style="color:#008080">ז</span> This is done to me, Because thy statutes I have observed.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#008080">ח</span> [Cheth.]</p>

<!-- PAGE 1007 -->
<span style="color:#800000">57</span> <span style="color:#008080">ח</span> *Thou art* my portion, O Jehovah! I have said that I will keep thy words.  <span style="color:#800000">ff141</span> <span style="color:#800000">58</span> <span style="color:#008080">ח</span> I have sought thy face with my whole heart; Have mercy upon me according to thy word.

<span style="color:#800000">59</span> <span style="color:#008080">ח</span> I thought upon my ways, And turned my feet to thy testimonies.

<span style="color:#800000">60</span> <span style="color:#008080">ח</span> I made haste and delayed not To keep thy commandments.

<span style="color:#800000">61</span> <span style="color:#008080">ח</span> The cords of the ungodly have caught hold of me; Thy law I have not forgotten.

<span style="color:#800000">62</span> <span style="color:#008080">ח</span> At midnight I will rise to praise thee, Because of the judgments of thy righteousness.

<span style="color:#800000">63</span> <span style="color:#008080">ח</span> A companion am I to all who fear thee, And who keep thy statutes.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">64</span> <span style="color:#008080">ח</span> Of thy mercy, O Jehovah! the earth is full: Thy statutes teach thou me.</p>

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#008080">ת</span> [Teth.]</p>

<span style="color:#800000">65</span> <span style="color:#008080">ת</span> Kindly hast thou dealt with thy servant, O Jehovah! According to thy word.

<span style="color:#800000">66</span> <span style="color:#008080">ת</span> Goodness of taste and knowledge teach me; For thy commandments I have believed.

<span style="color:#800000">67</span> <span style="color:#008080">ת</span> Before I was brought low I went astray; But now thy word I keep.

<span style="color:#800000">68</span> <span style="color:#008080">ת</span> Good *art* thou, and beneficent: Teach me thy statutes.

<span style="color:#800000">69</span> <span style="color:#008080">ת</span> Weaved a lie  <span style="color:#800000">ff142</span> against me have the proud ones; *But as for me* I with my whole heart will keep statutes.

<span style="color:#800000">70</span> <span style="color:#008080">ת</span> Fat as grease is their heart; *But as for me* I in thy law do delight.

<span style="color:#800000">71</span> <span style="color:#008080">ת</span> *It hath been* good for me that I have been afflicted, That I might learn thy statutes.

<!-- PAGE 1008 -->

<span style="color:#800000">72</span> <span style="color:#008080">ת</span> Better to me is the law of thy mouth Than thousands of gold and silver.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#008080">י</span> [Yod.]</p>

<span style="color:#800000">73</span> <span style="color:#008080">י</span> Thy hands have made and formed me; Make me to understand, and I shall learn thy commandments.

<span style="color:#800000">74</span> <span style="color:#008080">י</span> Those who fear thee shall see me and rejoice; Because for thy word I have waited.

<span style="color:#800000">75</span> <span style="color:#008080">י</span> I have known, O Jehovah! that righteousness are thy judgments; And in truth thou hast humbled me.

<span style="color:#800000">76</span> <span style="color:#008080">י</span> To thy word to thy servant.

<span style="color:#800000">77</span> <span style="color:#008080">י</span> Let come to me thy compassions, and I shall live; For thy law is my delight.

<span style="color:#800000">78</span> <span style="color:#008080">י</span> Ashamed let be the proud, for they have falsely wronged me: As for me I will meditate upon thy precepts.

<span style="color:#800000">79</span> <span style="color:#008080">י</span> Let those turn unto me who fear thee, And have known thy testimonies.

<span style="color:#800000">80</span> <span style="color:#008080">י</span> Let my heart be sound in thy statutes, That I may not be put to shame.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#008080">כ</span> [Caph.]</p>

<span style="color:#800000">81</span> <span style="color:#008080">כ</span> Fainted for thy salvation hath my soul: For thy word I wait.

<span style="color:#800000">82</span> <span style="color:#008080">כ</span> Failed have my eyes [*in looking*] for thy word, While I say, “When wilt thou comfort me?”

<span style="color:#800000">83</span> <span style="color:#008080">כ</span> For I have been as a bottle in the smoke; *And yet* thy statutes I have not forgotten.

<span style="color:#800000">84</span> <span style="color:#008080">כ</span> How many are the days of thy servant? When wilt thou execute judgment on my persecutors?

<!-- PAGE 1009 -->

<span style="color:#800000">85</span> <span style="color:#008080">כ</span> The proud have digged pits for me, Which is not according to thy law.

<span style="color:#800000">86</span> <span style="color:#008080">כ</span> All thy commandments are truth: Deceitfully do they persecute me; *therefore* help thou me.

<span style="color:#800000">87</span> <span style="color:#008080">כ</span> Almost have they consumed me upon the earth; Yet I have not forsaken thy statutes.

<span style="color:#800000">88</span> <span style="color:#008080">כ</span> According to thy goodness quicken me; And I will keep the testimony of thy mouth.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#008080">ל</span> [Lamed.]</p>

<span style="color:#800000">89</span> <span style="color:#008080">ל</span> For ever, O Jehovah! Thy word endureth in the heavens.

<span style="color:#800000">90</span> <span style="color:#008080">ל</span> From generation to generation *is* thy truth: Thou hast established the earth, and it abideth.

<span style="color:#800000">91</span> <span style="color:#008080">ל</span> By thy judgments they continue to this day; For all are thy servants.

<span style="color:#800000">92</span> <span style="color:#008080">ל</span> Unless thy law *had been* my delight, Then should I have perished in my affliction.

<span style="color:#800000">93</span> <span style="color:#008080">ל</span> Never will I forget thy statutes, For in them thou hast quickened me.

<span style="color:#800000">94</span> <span style="color:#008080">ל</span> Thine I am; O save me! For thy statutes I have sought.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">95</span> <span style="color:#008080">ל</span> For me wait do the ungodly to destroy me: *But* I consider thy testimonies.</p>

<span style="color:#800000">96</span> <span style="color:#008080">ל</span> In all perfection I have seen an end: Broad is thy commandment exceedingly.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#008080">מ</span> [Mem.]</p>

<span style="color:#800000">97</span> <span style="color:#008080">מ</span> O how have I loved thy law! All the day it is my meditation.

<span style="color:#800000">98</span> <span style="color:#008080">מ</span> Than my adversaries thou hast made me wiser by thy commandments; Because for ever they are with me.

<!-- PAGE 1010 -->

<span style="color:#800000">99</span> <span style="color:#008080">מ</span> Than all my teachers thou hast made me wiser; Because thy testimonies are my meditation.

<span style="color:#800000">100</span> <span style="color:#008080">מ</span> Than the aged I have more understanding; Because thy statutes I have observed.

<span style="color:#800000">101</span> <span style="color:#008080">מ</span> From every evil path I have restrained my feet, That I may keep thy word.

<span style="color:#800000">102</span> <span style="color:#008080">מ</span> From thy judgments I have not declined; For thou thyself hast taught me.

<span style="color:#800000">103</span> <span style="color:#008080">מ</span> How sweet to my palate have been thy words! More [*sweet*] than honey to my mouth!

<span style="color:#800000">104</span> <span style="color:#008080">מ</span> By thy statutes I have gotten understanding; Therefore I have hated every path of falsehood.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#008080">נ</span> [Nun.]</p>

<span style="color:#800000">105</span> <span style="color:#008080">נ</span> A lamp to my feet is thy word, And a light to my path.

<span style="color:#800000">106</span> <span style="color:#008080">נ</span> I have sworn and will make sure, To observe the judgments of thy righteousness.

<span style="color:#800000">107</span> <span style="color:#008080">נ</span> I am afflicted exceedingly, O Jehovah! Quicken me according to thy word.

<span style="color:#800000">108</span> <span style="color:#008080">נ</span> I Let the freewill *offerings* of my mouth, I pray thee, be pleasing to thee, O Jehovah! And thy judgments teach me.

<span style="color:#800000">109</span> <span style="color:#008080">נ</span> My soul *is* in my hand continually; And thy law I have not forgotten.

<span style="color:#800000">110</span> <span style="color:#008080">נ</span> Laid have the ungodly a snare for me: Yet from thy statutes I have not erred.

<span style="color:#800000">111</span> <span style="color:#008080">נ</span> I have as [*my*] inheritance thy testimonies for ever; For the joy of my heart are they.

<!-- PAGE 1011 -->

<span style="color:#800000">112</span> <span style="color:#008080">נ</span> I have inclined my heart to perform thy statutes For ever, and even to the end.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#008080">ס</span> [Samech.]</p>

<span style="color:#800000">113</span> <span style="color:#008080">ס</span> *Crooked* thoughts I have hated; But thy law I have loved.

<span style="color:#800000">114</span> <span style="color:#008080">ס</span> My hiding-place and my shield art thou: In thy word I have trusted.

<span style="color:#800000">115</span> <span style="color:#008080">ס</span> Depart from me, ye wicked men! And I will keep the commandments of my God.

<span style="color:#800000">116</span> <span style="color:#008080">ס</span> Sustain me by thy word, and I shall live: And make me not ashamed of my expectation.

<span style="color:#800000">117</span> <span style="color:#008080">ס</span> Establish me, and I shall be safe, And I will consider thy statutes continually.

<span style="color:#800000">118</span> <span style="color:#008080">ס</span> Thou hast trodden down all who go astray from thy statutes; For falsehood is their deceit.

<span style="color:#800000">119</span> <span style="color:#008080">ס</span> *As* dross thou hast made to cease all the ungodly of the earth; Therefore I have loved thy testimonies.

<span style="color:#800000">120</span> <span style="color:#008080">ס</span> Tremble  <span style="color:#800000">ff143</span> for fear of thee did my flesh, And of thy judgments I was afraid.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#008080">ע</span> [Ain.]</p>

<span style="color:#800000">121</span> <span style="color:#008080">ע</span> I have done judgment and righteousness: Give me not up to my oppressors.

<span style="color:#800000">122</span> <span style="color:#008080">ע</span> Become surety for thy servant for good, That the proud may not oppress me.

<span style="color:#800000">123</span> <span style="color:#008080">ע</span> My eyes have failed for thy salvation, And for the word of thy righteousness.

<span style="color:#800000">124</span> <span style="color:#008080">ע</span> Deal with thy servant according to thy goodness, And thy statutes teach thou me.

<!-- PAGE 1012 -->

<span style="color:#800000">125</span> <span style="color:#008080">ע</span> Thy servant am I, give me understanding, That I may learn thy testimonies.

<span style="color:#800000">126</span> <span style="color:#008080">ע</span> *It is* time [*for thee*] to work, O Jehovah! *For they* have destroyed thy law.

<span style="color:#800000">127</span> <span style="color:#008080">ע</span> Therefore I have loved thy statutes Mere than gold and fine gold.

<span style="color:#800000">128</span> <span style="color:#008080">ע</span> Therefore all *thy* commandments I have esteemed *to be* altogether right: Every way of falsehood I have hated:

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#008080">פ</span> [Phe.]</p>

<span style="color:#800000">129</span> <span style="color:#008080">פ</span> Marvelous things *are* thy testimonies; Therefore observed them hath my soul.

<span style="color:#800000">130</span> <span style="color:#008080">פ</span> The entrance of thy words is light, Giving understanding to the little ones.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">131</span> <span style="color:#008080">פ</span> My mouth I opened and panted, Because thy commandments I loved.</p>

<span style="color:#800000">132</span> <span style="color:#008080">פ</span> Look upon me and have pity upon me, According to *thy* judgment towards those who love thy name.

<span style="color:#800000">133</span> <span style="color:#008080">פ</span> My steps direct thou according to thy word, And let not any iniquity have dominion in me.

<span style="color:#800000">134</span> <span style="color:#008080">פ</span> Redeem me from the oppression of men, And I will keep thy precepts.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">135</span> <span style="color:#008080">פ</span> Thy face cause thou to shine upon thy servant, And teach me thy statutes.</p>

<span style="color:#800000">136</span> <span style="color:#008080">פ</span> Rivers of waters run from my eyes, Because they have not kept thy law.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#008080">צ</span> [Tsadde.]</p>

<span style="color:#800000">137</span> <span style="color:#008080">צ</span> Righteous art thou, O Jehovah! And right *are* thy judgments.

<!-- PAGE 1013 -->

<span style="color:#800000">138</span> <span style="color:#008080">צ</span> Thou hast commanded righteousness *in* thy testimonies, And truth exceedingly.

<span style="color:#800000">139</span> <span style="color:#008080">צ</span> Consumed me hath my zeal, Because forgotten thy words have my adversaries.

<span style="color:#800000">140</span> <span style="color:#008080">צ</span> Refined *is* thy word exceedingly: And thy servant hath loved it.

<span style="color:#800000">141</span> <span style="color:#008080">צ</span> Small *am* I, and despised; [*Yet*] thy precepts I have not forgotten.

<span style="color:#800000">142</span> <span style="color:#008080">צ</span> Thy righteousness *is* righteousness for ever, And thy law is truth.

<span style="color:#800000">143</span> <span style="color:#008080">צ</span> Trouble and anguish have come upon me; *But* thy commandments *have been* my delights.

<span style="color:#800000">144</span> <span style="color:#008080">צ</span> The righteousness of thy testimonies *endureth* for ever; Make me to understand, and I shall live.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#008080">ק</span> [Koph.]</p>

<span style="color:#800000">145</span> <span style="color:#008080">ק</span> I have cried with my whole heart; Answer me, O Jehovah! *And* thy statutes I will keep.

<span style="color:#800000">146</span> <span style="color:#008080">ק</span> I have called upon thee, save me, And I will keep thy testimonies.

<span style="color:#800000">147</span> <span style="color:#008080">ק</span> I have prevented the dawn of the morning, <span style="color:#800000">ff144</span> and have cried: To thy word I have looked up.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">148</span> <span style="color:#008080">ק</span> Prevented have my eyes the watches *of the night*, To meditate upon thy word.</p>

<span style="color:#800000">149</span> <span style="color:#008080">ק</span> My voice hear thou, according to thy mercy, O Jehovah According to thy judgment quicken me.

<span style="color:#800000">150</span> <span style="color:#008080">ק</span> Drawn near have the pursuers of malice; From thy law they have departed.

<!-- PAGE 1014 -->

<span style="color:#800000">151</span> <span style="color:#008080">ק</span> Near art thou, O Jehovah! And all thy commandments *are* truth.

<span style="color:#800000">152</span> <span style="color:#008080">ק</span> From the beginning I have known from thy testimonies, That for ever thou hast founded them.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#008080">ר</span> [Resh.]</p>

<span style="color:#800000">153</span> <span style="color:#008080">ר</span> Behold my affliction, and rescue me; For thy law I have not forgotten.

<span style="color:#800000">154</span> <span style="color:#008080">ר</span> Debate my cause, and redeem me; According to thy word quicken me.

<span style="color:#800000">155</span> <span style="color:#008080">ר</span> Far from the ungodly is safety; Because thy statutes they have not sought.

<span style="color:#800000">156</span> <span style="color:#008080">ר</span> Thy compassions *are* great, O Jehovah! According to thy judgments quicken me.

<span style="color:#800000">157</span> <span style="color:#008080">ר</span> Many *are* my persecutors and my oppressors: From thy testimonies I have not declined.

<span style="color:#800000">158</span> <span style="color:#008080">ר</span> I saw the perfidious, and chid them; Because thy word they have not kept.

<span style="color:#800000">159</span> <span style="color:#008080">ר</span> Behold how thy commandments I have loved: According to thy clemency quicken me.

<span style="color:#800000">160</span> <span style="color:#008080">ר</span> The beginning of thy word *is* truth; And to everlasting *is* all the judgment of thy righteousness.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#008080">ש</span> [Shin.]</p>

<span style="color:#800000">161</span> <span style="color:#008080">ש</span> Princes have persecuted me without a cause Yet at thy word afraid hath been my heart.

<span style="color:#800000">162</span> <span style="color:#008080">ש</span> Joyful am I over thy word, As he who hath found much spoil.

<span style="color:#800000">163</span> <span style="color:#008080">ש</span> Deceit I *have* hated and abhorred; Thy law I *have* loved.

<!-- PAGE 1015 -->

<span style="color:#800000">164</span> <span style="color:#008080">ש</span> Seven times a day have I praised thee, Because of the judgments of thy righteousness.

<span style="color:#800000">165</span> <span style="color:#008080">ש</span> Much peace have those who love thy law, And they have no stumbling-block.

<span style="color:#800000">166</span> <span style="color:#008080">ש</span> I have waited for thy salvation, O Jehovah! And thy commandments I have done.

<span style="color:#800000">167</span> <span style="color:#008080">ש</span> Kept hath my soul thy testimonies, And I have loved them exceedingly.

<span style="color:#800000">168</span> <span style="color:#008080">ש</span> I have kept thy commandments and thy testimonies; For all my ways *are* before thee.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#008080">ת</span> [Thau.]</p>

<span style="color:#800000">169</span> <span style="color:#008080">ת</span> Come let my cry into thy presence, O Jehovah! According to thy word give me understanding.

<span style="color:#800000">170</span> <span style="color:#008080">ת</span> Come let my prayer into thy presence: According to thy word deliver me.

<span style="color:#800000">171</span> <span style="color:#008080">ת</span> Speak shall my lips praise, When thou shalt have taught me thy statutes.

<span style="color:#800000">172</span> <span style="color:#008080">ת</span> Speak shall my tongue of thy word; For all thy precepts are righteousness.

<span style="color:#800000">173</span> <span style="color:#008080">ת</span> Let thy hand be to succor me; For thy commandments I have chosen.

<span style="color:#800000">174</span> <span style="color:#008080">ת</span> I have longed for thy salvation, O Jehovah! And thy law *hath been* my delights.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">175</span> <span style="color:#008080">ת</span> Live let my soul, and let it praise thee; And let thy judgments succor me.</p>

<span style="color:#800000">176</span> <span style="color:#008080">ת</span> I have wandered like a lost sheep; Seek thy servant, for thy statutes I have not forgotten.

<!-- PAGE 1016 -->

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 120</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*A Song of Degrees*</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> To Jehovah in my distress I cried, And he answered me.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> O Jehovah! deliver my soul from the lip of falsehood, From the tongue of deceit.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> What give thee, and what avail thee Shall the tongue of deceit?

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> The arrows of a strong *man* sharpened, With coals of junipers.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> Alas for me! that I have been a sojourner in Meseeh, *And* have dwelt among the tents of Kedar.

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> Long dwelt hath my soul with him who hateth peace.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> I [*am for*] peace; But when I speak, they [*are*] for war.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 121</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*A Song of Degrees*</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> I will lift up my eyes to the mountains, Whence come shall my help.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> My help *cometh* from Jehovah, Who made heaven and earth.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> He will not suffer thy foot to stumble; Slumber not shall thy guardian.

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> Behold! slumber not nor sleep Shall the guardian of Israel.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> Jehovah *is* thy guardian; Jehovah *is thy* defense on thy right hand.

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> By day the sun shall not smite thee, Nor the moon by night.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> Jehovah shall keep thee from all evil; He shall keep thy soul.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> Jehovah shall keep thy going out and thy coming in, From this time, and for ever.

<!-- PAGE 1017 -->

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 122</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*A Song of Degrees Of David*</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">1</span> I was glad when they said to me, “Into the house of Jehovah we will go.</p>

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> “Our feet shall be standing in thy gates, O Jerusalem!”

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> Jerusalem built as a city, compact in itself together.

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> Thither ascended the tribes, the tribes of God, For a testimony to Israel, To celebrate the name of Jehovah.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> For there have sat  <span style="color:#800000">ff145</span> thrones for judgment, The thrones of the house of David.

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> Pray ye for the peace of Jerusalem: Prosper may those who love thee!

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> Peace be within thy bulwark! Prosperity within thy towers!

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> For the sake of my brethren and my neighbors, I will say now, “Peace [*be*] within thee! “ <span style="color:#800000">9</span> For the sake of the house of Jehovah our God, I will seek good for thee.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 123</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*A Song of Degrees*</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> To thee will I lift up mine eyes, [*O thou*] who dwellest in the heavens!

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> Behold! as the eyes of servants look to the hand of their masters; As the eyes of a handmaid *look* to the hand of her mistress, So our eyes [*look*] to Jehovah our God, Until he have mercy upon us.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> Have mercy upon us, O Jehovah! have mercy upon us; For we are exceedingly filled with reproach.

<!-- PAGE 1018 -->

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> Exceedingly filled in itself is our soul With the mockery of the rich, With the contempt of the proud.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 124</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*A Song of Degrees. Of David*</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">1</span> “But for Jehovah who was on our side” — Say now may Israel:</p>

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> “But for Jehovah who was on our side, “When men rose up against us;

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> “Then alive had they swallowed us up, “When kindled was their wrath against us;

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> “Then the waters had overwhelmed us, “The torrent had gone over our soul:

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> “Then had gone over our soul the proud waters.”

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> Blessed *be* Jehovah, Who gave us not for a prey to their teeth.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> Our soul as a bird, hath been rescued  <span style="color:#800000">ff146</span> from the snare of the fowlers; The snare hath been broken, and we have been delivered.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> Our help *is* in the name of Jehovah, Who made heaven and earth.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 125</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*A Song of Degrees*</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> They who confide in Jehovah *are as* mount Zion, *Which* shall not be removed, *but* shall abide for ever.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> As the mountains *are* about Jerusalem, So Jehovah *is* round about his people, From henceforth, and for ever.

<!-- PAGE 1019 -->

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> For rest not shall the scepter of the ungodly ones upon the lot of the just, Lest the just ones should put forth to iniquity their hands.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">4</span> Do good, O Jehovah! to the good, And to *those who* are upright in their hearts.</p>

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> But those who turn aside into their crooked paths, Jehovah shall make them walk with the workers of iniquity: *But there shall be* peace upon Israel.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 126</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*A Song of Degrees*</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> When bring back did Jehovah the captivity of Zion, We were like those that dream.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> Now filled with laughter *shall* be our mouth, And our tongue with exultation: Now shall they say among the heathen, “Great things Jehovah hath done for them.”

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> Great things Jehovah hath done for us, *Whereof* we have been made glad.

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> Bring back, O Jehovah! our captivity, As rivers in the South.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> They who sow in tears In exultation shall reap.

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> Going forth, he shall go and weep, Carrying the price of the seed: Returning he shall return with exultation, Bearing his sheaves.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 127</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*A Song of Degrees. Of Solomon*</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> Except Jehovah build the house, In vain they labor that build it; Except Jehovah keep the city, In vain watcheth the watchman.

<!-- PAGE 1020 -->

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> Vain *is it* for you early to hasten to rise, To go late to rest, To eat the bread of sorrows: *For* thus will he give to his beloved one sleep.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> Lo! the heritage of Jehovah are children: The reward *which he bestows* is the fruit of the womb.

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> As arrows in the hand of a strong man, So *are* the sons of youth.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> Blessed is the man who shall have filled his quiver with them; *For* they shall not be ashamed when they speak with their enemies in the gate.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 128</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*A Song of Degrees*</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> Blessed *is* the man who feareth Jehovah, Who walketh in his ways.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> The labor of thy hands when thou shalt eat thou shalt be blessed, And it *shall be* well with thee.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> Thy wife *shall be* as a vine fruitful on the sides of thy house: Thy children as plants of olives around thy table.

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> Lo! surely, thus blessed shall be the man who feareth Jehovah.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> Bless thee shall Jehovah from Zion; And thou shalt see the good of Jerusalem all the days of thy life.

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> And thou shalt see thy children’s children, *And* peace upon Israel.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 129</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*A Song of Degrees*</span></p>

<!-- PAGE 1021 -->

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> “Often have they afflicted me from my youths” Say now let Israel:

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> “Often have they afflicted me from my youth; “Yet they have not prevailed against me.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">3</span> “Upon my back ploughed have the ploughers; “They have made long their furrows.</p>

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> “Jehovah, who is righteous, hath cut asunder the cords of the wicked.”

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> Confounded and turned backward shall be all who hate Zion.

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> They shall be as the grass of the housetops, Which before it cometh forth is withered:

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> With which the mower hath not filled his hand, Nor his bosom he who gathereth handfuls.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> Nor have they said who pass by, “The blessing of Jehovah *be* upon you, “We bless you in the name of Jehovah.”

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 130</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*A Song of Degrees*</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> Out of the depths have I cried to thee, O Jehovah!

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> O Lord! hear my voice; Let thy ears be attentive to the voice of my prayers.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> If iniquities thou shouldest mark, O God! O Lord! who shall stand?

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> For with thee is forgiveness that thou mayest be feared.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> I have waited for Jehovah, waited hath my soul; And in his word have I hoped.

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> My soul [*hath waited*] for the Lord Before the watchers of the morning, the watchers of the morning.

<!-- PAGE 1022 -->

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> But  <span style="color:#800000">ff147</span> hope let Israel in Jehovah; For with Jehovah *there is* mercy, And with him there is plenteous redemption.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> And he shall redeem Israel from all his iniquities.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 131</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*A Song of Degrees. Of David*</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> O Jehovah! my heart hath not been elated, Nor lifted up have been my eyes, Nor have I exercised myself in great matters, Or in things hidden from me.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> If I have not framed [*or set*] and quieted my soul, Like one that is weaned from his mother, —  <span style="color:#800000">ff148</span> Like a child that is weaned is my soul upon me.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> Hope shall Israel in Jehovah From henceforth, and for ever.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 132</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*A Song of Degrees*</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> Remember, O Jehovah! David With all his affliction:

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> Who sware to Jehovah, [*Who*] vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob:

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> “If I shall enter into the tabernacle of my house, “If I shall go up upon the covering of my bed, <span style="color:#800000">4</span> “If I give sleep to my eyes, “To my eyelids slumber, <span style="color:#800000">5</span> “Until I find a place for Jehovah, “Habitations for the mighty God of Jacob,” —  <span style="color:#800000">ff149</span> <span style="color:#800000">6</span> Lo! we heard of it at Ephratha; We found it in the fields of the wood.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> We will enter into his habitations, We will worship at his footstool.

<!-- PAGE 1023 -->

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> Arise, O Jehovah! into thy rest, Thou and the ark of thy strength.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">9</span> Let thy priests be clothed with righteousness, And let thy meek ones exult.</p>

<span style="color:#800000">10</span> For the sake of David thy servant Turn not away the face of thy Christ.

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> Sworn hath Jehovah to David in truth, Nor will he turn from it: “Of the fruit of thy belly will I set upon thy throne.

<span style="color:#800000">12</span> “If thy children shall keep my covenant, “And my testimonies, which I will teach them; “Also their children for ever shall sit upon thy throne.”

<span style="color:#800000">13</span> For chosen hath Jehovah Zion; He hath desired her for a habitation to himself.

<span style="color:#800000">14</span> “This is my rest for ever; “Here will I dwell, because I have loved her.

<span style="color:#800000">15</span> “Her provision blessing I will bless; “Her poor I will satisfy with bread; .

<span style="color:#800000">16</span> “And her priests I will clothe with salvation; “And her merciful ones with exultation shall exult.

<span style="color:#800000">17</span> “There will I make to bud the horn of David: “I have prepared a lamp for my Christ.

<span style="color:#800000">18</span> “His enemies will I clothe with shame, “And upon him flourish shall his crown.”

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 133</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*A Song of Degrees. Of David*</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> Behold! how good, and how becoming, That brethren should even dwell together!

<!-- PAGE 1024 -->

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> Like the precious oil upon the head, Which descendeth  <span style="color:#800000">ff150</span> upon the beard, the beard of Aaron, Which descendeth upon the skirt of his garments.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> Like the dew of Hermon, Which descendeth upon the mountains of Zion: For there commanded hath Jehovah the blessing, Life for evermore.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 134</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*A Song of Degrees*</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> Behold! bless ye Jehovah, All ye servants of Jehovah! Who stand in the house of Jehovah nightly.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> Lift up your hands to the sanctuary, And bless ye Jehovah.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> May Jehovah bless thee out of Zion, [*Even he*] who hath made heaven and earth.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 135</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*Hallelujah*</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> Praise ye the name of Jehovah; Praise [*it*] O ye servants of Jehovah!

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> Who stand in the house of Jehovah, [*And ye who stand*] in the courts of the house of our God.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> Praise God; for good *is* Jehovah: Sing to his name; for it is pleasant:

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> For God hath chosen Jacob to himself, Israel for his own possession.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> For I know that great is Jehovah, And *that* our God is above all gods.

<!-- PAGE 1025 -->

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> All things which Jehovah pleaseth, lie doeth in the heavens and on the earth, In the sea and in all the deeps.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> Causing the clouds to ascend from the end of the earth: The lightnings for the rain he maketh, Bringing forth the wind out of his secret places.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> He smote the first born of Egypt, From man even unto beast.

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> He sent signs and wonders in the midst of thee, O Egypt! On Pharaoh and on all his servants.

<span style="color:#800000">10</span> He smote great nations, And slew mighty kings.

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> Sihon, king of the Amorites, And Og the king of Basham, And all the kingdoms of Canaan.

<span style="color:#800000">12</span> And gave their land for an heritage, An heritage to Israel, his people.

<span style="color:#800000">13</span> O Jehovah! thy name *is* for ever; O Jehovah! thy memorial *is* from generation to generation.

<span style="color:#800000">14</span> For judge will Jehovah his people, And concerning his servants he will repent himself.

<span style="color:#800000">15</span> The images of the nations *are* silver and gold, The work of the hands of man.

<span style="color:#800000">16</span> A mouth have they, and they will not speak;  <span style="color:#800000">ff151</span> Eyes have they, and they will not see.

<span style="color:#800000">17</span> Ears have they, and they will not hear: Also, there is no breath in their mouth.

<span style="color:#800000">18</span> Like unto them are those who make them, *And* every one who trusteth in them.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">19</span> O house of Israel! bless ye Jehovah; O house of Aaron! bless ye Jehovah;</p>

<span style="color:#800000">20</span> O house of Levi! bless ye Jehovah; O ye who fear Jehovah! bless ye Jehovah.

<!-- PAGE 1026 -->

<span style="color:#800000">21</span> Blessed *be* Jehovah out of Zion, Who dwelleth at Jerusalem. Hallelujah.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 136</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> Praise Jehovah, for *he is* good,  For to everlasting *endureth* his mercy.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> Praise the God of gods, For to everlasting *endureth* his mercy.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> Praise the Lord of lords, For to everlasting *endureth* his mercy.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">4</span> Who hath done wonders great alone, For to everlasting *endureth* his mercy.</p>

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> Who hath made the heavens in wisdom, For to everlasting *endureth* his mercy.

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> Who hath stretched out the earth above the waters, For to everlasting *endureth* his mercy.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> Who hath made the great lights, For to everlasting *endureth* his mercy.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> The sun for rule by day, For to everlasting *endureth* his mercy.

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> The moon and stars for rule by night, For to everlasting *endureth* his mercy.

<span style="color:#800000">10</span> Who smote the Egyptians in their first born, For to everlasting *endureth* his mercy.

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> And brought out Israel from the midst of them, For to everlasting *endureth* his mercy.

<span style="color:#800000">12</span> With a hand of strength and an arm stretched out, For to everlasting *endureth* his mercy.

<span style="color:#800000">13</span> Who divided the Red Sea into divisions, For to everlasting *endureth* his mercy.

<!-- PAGE 1027 -->

<span style="color:#800000">14</span> And made Israel to pass through the midst of it, For to everlasting *endureth* his mercy.

<span style="color:#800000">15</span> And cast Pharaoh and his host headlong into the Red Sea, For to everlasting *endureth* his mercy.

<span style="color:#800000">16</span> And led his people through the wilderness, For to everlasting *endureth* his mercy.

<span style="color:#800000">17</span> Who smote great kings, For to everlasting *endureth* his mercy.

<span style="color:#800000">18</span> And slew renowned kings, For to everlasting *endureth* his mercy.

<span style="color:#800000">19</span> Sihon, king of the Arnorites, For to everlasting *endureth* his mercy.

<span style="color:#800000">20</span> And Og, the king of Bashan, For to everlasting *endureth* his mercy.

<span style="color:#800000">21</span> And gave their land for an heritage, For to everlasting *endureth* his mercy.

<span style="color:#800000">22</span> An heritage to Israel his servant, For to everlasting *endureth* his mercy.

<span style="color:#800000">23</span> Who in our humiliation remembered us, For to everlasting *endureth* his mercy.

<span style="color:#800000">24</span> And rescued us from our oppressors, For to everlasting *endureth* his mercy.

<span style="color:#800000">25</span> Who giveth food to all flesh, For to everlasting *endureth* his mercy.

<span style="color:#800000">26</span> Make acknowledgments to the God of heavens, For to everlasting *endureth* his mercy.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 137</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down, Yea we wept when we remembered thee, O Zion!

<!-- PAGE 1028 -->

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> Upon the willows, in the midst thereof, We hanged our harps.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> Then they required of us, they who carried us away captive, the words of a song, And, when we were in suspense, mirth, [*Saying*] Sing us one of the songs of Zion.”

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> How shall we sing the song of Jehovah, In a strange land?

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> If I shall forget thee, O Jerusalem! Forget let my right hand [*its cunning*.] <span style="color:#800000">6</span> Cleave let my tongue to my palate, If I do not remember thee, If I do not raise Jerusalem above my highest joy. <span style="color:#800000">ff152</span> <span style="color:#800000">7</span> Remember, O Jehovah! the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem: ‘Who said, “Lay it bare — “Lay it bare, even to the foundations thereof.”

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> O daughter of Babylon laid waste! Happy he who shall repay thee The retribution with which thou hast retributed us!

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> Happy he who shall take And dash thy little ones against the stones.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 138</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*Of David*</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> I will celebrate thee with my whole heart; Before the gods! will sing psalms to thee.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> I will worship *thee* towards the temple of thy holiness, And sing to thy name for thy mercy and for thy truth; For thou hast magnified above all *things* thy name by thy word.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> In the day *when*, I cried *to thee*, then thou heardest me, Thou didst abundantly minister to me strength in my soul.

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> Celebrate thee, O Jehovah! let all the kings of the earth; For they have heard the words of thy mouth.

<!-- PAGE 1029 -->

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">5</span> And let them sing in the ways of Jehovah, For great is the glory of Jehovah.</p>

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> For high *is* Jehovah; yet the lowly he will regard; And being high will know afar off:

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> If I shall walk in the midst of trouble, thou wilt revive me; Against the wrath of my enemies thou wilt put forth thy hand, And save me shall thy right hand.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> Jehovah will perform in me *his work*, O Jehovah! thy mercy is from everlasting; The works of thy hands thou wilt not forsake.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 139</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David*</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> O Jehovah! thou hast searched me and known *me*.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> Thou hast known my down sitting and my uprising, Thou understandest my thought afar off.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> My path and my lying down thou besiegest, And with all my ways thou art acquainted.

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> For there is not a word in my tongue [*But*] lo! O God! thou knowest it altogether.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">5</span> Behind and before thou hast shut me up, And hast laid upon me thy hand.</p>

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> Wonderful is *thy* knowledge above me; It is high, I cannot *attain* to it.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> Whither shall I go from thy Spirit? And whither from thy time shall I flee?

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">8</span> If I ascend up into the heavens, there thou art; If I lie down  <span style="color:#800000">ff153</span></p>

<p style="margin-left:2em;" markdown="1">in the sepulcher, behold! thou [*art there*.]</p>

<!-- PAGE 1030 -->
<span style="color:#800000">9</span> Should I take the wings of the morning, That I may dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea, <span style="color:#800000">10</span> Even there thy hand shall lead me, And hold me shall thy right hand.

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> If I should say: “At least the darkness shall cover me; “And the night shall be light for me; “ <span style="color:#800000">12</span> Even the darkness shall not hide from the And the night as the day shall shine, And the darkness as the light.

<span style="color:#800000">13</span> For thou hast possessed my reins; Thou hast covered me in the womb of my mother.

<span style="color:#800000">14</span> I will celebrate thee; for I have been fearfully and wonderfully made:  <span style="color:#800000">ff154</span> Marvelous are thy works, And my soul shall know them full well.

<span style="color:#800000">15</span> Not hidden is my strength from thee, Which thou hast made in secret: I was woven together in the lowest parts of the earth.

<span style="color:#800000">16</span> My shapelessness see did thine eyes; <span style="color:#800000">ff155</span> In thy book all shall be written; They were formed *in many* days, And *there was* not one of them.

<span style="color:#800000">17</span> And towards me how precious are thy thoughts, O God! How great *are* the sums of them!

<span style="color:#800000">18</span> If I should count them; above the sand they shall be multiplied: I am awakened, and still I am with thee.

<span style="color:#800000">19</span> If thou shalt slay, O God! the wicked, Then ye men of bloods depart from me.

<span style="color:#800000">20</span> Who have spoken of thee wickedly: Taken thy name falsely have thy adversaries.

<span style="color:#800000">21</span> Thy haters, O Jehovah! shall not I hate? And with those that rise up against thee shall I not strive?

<span style="color:#800000">22</span> With perfect hatred I have hated them, As my enemies I have held them.

<span style="color:#800000">23</span> Search me, O God! and know my heart: Examine me and know my thoughts.

<!-- PAGE 1031 -->

<span style="color:#800000">24</span> And know whether the way of wickedness be in me, And lead me in the way of this life.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 140</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David*</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> Deliver me, O Jehovah! from the evil man: From the man of injuries do thou preserve me.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> Who devise mischiefs in *their* heart; Daily do they congregate for wars.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> Sharpened have they their tongue like a serpent: The poison of an asp is under their lips. Selah.

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> Keep me, O Jehovah! from the hands of the ungodly: From the man of injuries preserve me; Who plot to overthrow my goings.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> Laid have the proud a snare for me: And with cords they have spread a net: By the wayside traps have they set for me. Selah.

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> I said, O Jehovah! my God are thou: Listen, O Jehovah! to the voice of my supplication.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> O Jehovah, my Lord! the strength of my salvation, Thou hast put a covering on my head in the day of arms.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> Grant not, O Jehovah! the desires of the ungodly man: They have devised, consummate thou not, they shall be exalted. Selah.

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> [*As for*] the head of those who encompass me, Let the mischief of his lips cover him.

<span style="color:#800000">10</span> Fall upon them let coals with fire: He shall cast them into deep pits, They shall not rise again.

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> The man of tongue shall not be established in the earth: The man of violence, evil shall hunt him to banishments.

<span style="color:#800000">12</span> I have known that accomplish will Jehovah the judgment of the poor one, The judgment of the afflicted one.

<!-- PAGE 1032 -->

<span style="color:#800000">13</span> Surely the righteous ones will celebrate thy name, Dwell shall the upright ones before thy face.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 141</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*A Psalm of David*</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> O Jehovah! I have cried to thee: Haste thou to me: Listen to my voice when I cry to thee.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> Directed let my prayer be as incense before thy face: [*Let*] the lifting up of my hands [*be*] as the sacrifice of the evening.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> Set, O Jehovah! a watch to my mouth; Keep a guard upon the door of my lips.

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> Incline not my heart to an evil thing, To commit works of ungodliness with the men who work iniquity; And let me not eat of their dainties.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> Smite me let the righteous man, [*it shall be*] a kindness; And let him chastise me, [*it shall be*] an oil that is precious, It shall not break my head: For yet also my prayer *shall be* in their calamities.

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> Cast down on stony places have been their judges: And they shall hear my words, for they are sweet.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> As he who breaketh and cutteth on the earth, Scattered have been our bones at the mouth of the grave.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> Because to thee, O Jehovah! my Lord! *are* my eyes, In thee I have hoped: do not leave destitute my soul.

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> Keep me from the hands of the snare which they have spread for me. From the nets of those who work iniquity.

<span style="color:#800000">10</span> Fall into his nets let the ungodly ones together, Until I escape.

<!-- PAGE 1033 -->

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 142</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*Maschil of David, when he was in the cave. A Prayer*</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> With my voice to, Jehovah I cried; With my voice to. Jehovah I made supplication.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> I poured out before his face my meditation; My affliction before his face I declare.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> When perplexed within me was my spirit, And thou knewest my path: In the way wherein I walked, they laid a snare for me.

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> On looking to the right hand, and beholding, None there was who would know me, Perish did refuge from me, [*There was*] no man seeking after my soul.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> I cried to thee, O Jehovah! I said, Thou *art* my hope, My portion in the land of the living.

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> Attend to my cry, For under affliction I labor exceedingly: Deliver me from my persecutors, For they are too strong for me.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> Rescue from prison my soul, That I may celebrate thy name: Crown me shall the righteous ones, For thou shalt recompense me.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 143</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*A Psalm of David*</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> O Jehovah! hear my prayer; Give ear to my supplication; In thy truth answer me, in thy righteousness.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> And enter not into judgment with thy servant, For there shall not be justified in thy sight any living man.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> For persecuted hath the enemy my soul; He hath prostrated on the earth my life; He hath set me in dark *places*, as the dead of an age.

<!-- PAGE 1034 -->

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> And perplexed within me is my spirit Within me astonished is my heart.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> I remembered the days of old, I meditated on all thy doings; Upon the work of thy hands I meditated.

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> I spread out my hearts to thee; My soul, as the earth without water, *is* to thee. Selah.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> Hasten, answer me, O Jehovah! Fail doth my spirit: Hide not thy face from me, Because I shall be like to those who descend into the pit.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> Cause me to hear in the morning thy mercy, For in thee have I hoped: Show me the way in which I may walk, For to thee have I lifted up my soul.

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> Deliver me from my enemies, O Jehovah! With thee have I hidden [*myself*.] <span style="color:#800000">10</span> Teach me to do thy will, For thou *art* my God: Let thy good Spirit lead me into the right land.

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> Because of thy name, O Jehovah I thou wilt quicken me: In thy righteousness bring out of trouble my soul.

<span style="color:#800000">12</span> And in thy mercy thou wilt scatter my enemies, And wilt destroy all those who afflict my soul; Because I *am* thy servant.

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 144</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*Of David*</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> Blessed *be* Jehovah, my strength, Who teacheth my hands for the fight, My fingers for the battle.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> My goodness, and my fortress, My citadel, my deliverer for me, My shield, and in him I have hoped, Who subdueth my people under me.

<!-- PAGE 1035 -->

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> O Jehovah! what is man that thou acknowledgest him? The son of man that thou thinkest of him?

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> Man to vanity is like, His days [*are*] as a shadow that is passing.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> O Jehovah! bow thy heavens and descend: Touch the mountains and they shall smoke.

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> Thunder forth thunderings and scatter them; Shoot out thy arrows, and destroy them.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> Send thy hand from on high; Rescue me and deliver me from waters great, From the hand of the sons of the alien.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> For their mouth hath spoken falsehood, And their right hand is a right hand of deceit.

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> O God! a song that is new I will sing to thee: Upon the nablum, upon the psaltery I will sing psalms to thee <span style="color:#800000">10</span> Who givest salvation to kings, Who redeemest David his servant from the hurtful sword.

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> Redeem me, and rescue me, From the hand of the sons of the alien, Whose mouth hath spoken falsehood, And their right hand *is* a right hand of deceit.

<span style="color:#800000">12</span> Because our sons *are* as plants Which have grown up in their youth; Our daughters as corners polished After the similitude of a palace.

<span style="color:#800000">13</span> Our recesses full, Supplying all kinds of good things. Our sheep bringing forth thousands, [*Yea*] ten thousands in our streets.

<span style="color:#800000">14</span> Our oxen to the burden accustomed; No breach, nor going out, Nor cry in our streets.

<span style="color:#800000">15</span> Happy the people to whom it is so, To whom Jehovah is their God.

<!-- PAGE 1036 -->

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">PSALM 145</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center; color:#000080; margin:14px 2em;"><span style="color:#000080">*Praise of David*</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">1</span> I will exalt thee, my God, *my* King! And will bless thy name for ever and ever.</p>

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> Every day will I bless thee, And praise thy name for ever and ever.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> Great *is* Jehovah, and to be praised greatly, And his greatness is incomprehensible.

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> Generation to generation shall praise thy works, And thy power they shall declare.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> Upon the majesty of the glory of thy excellence, And upon the words of thy wonders, I will meditate.

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> And the might of thy terrible *works* shall they recount; And thy greatness I will declare.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> The memory of the greatness of thy goodness they shall speak forth; And of thy righteousness they shall sing.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">8</span> Gracious and compassionate *is* Jehovah, Slow to anger and great in clemency.</p>

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> Good *is* Jehovah to all, And his compassions *are* over all his works.

<span style="color:#800000">10</span> Celebrate thee, O Jehovah! shall all thy works, And thy meek ones shall bless thee.

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> Of the glory of thy kingdom they shall tell, And of thy power they shall speak:

<span style="color:#800000">12</span> To make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, And the glory of the beauty of his kingdom.
